method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations: EP-01 here covers four items. The tier and availability-finder machinery (catch-up Phases 17, 28, 32) is built and well factored: one ranking rule (rankAnaesthetistCandidates), one admin picker (AnaesthetistCandidates, reused by Find available, Reassign and Draft List) and one anaesthetist-side receive rule (listMoves.ts receiveRefusal/pushTargets). The anaesthetist apps never import tier or pairing code, which supports US-01.3.6 and US-01.4.5. Real gaps: (1) US-01.4.7, the anaesthetist single-Booking move, is absent (planned as Phase 32a; needs a store action creating a new List in the receiver's open Slot, a Booking-detail entry on mobile and web, a receiver picker reusing pushTargets, a new NotificationKind and optional update email, and prepaid-payable handling per US-06.5.4/US-01.4.6, with OQ-85 settled). (2) The type-ahead name search required by US-01.4.2 and US-01.4.7 exists only on the web availability grid; it should be one small shared component added to MoveListSheet's colleague step, the mobile Find cover screen and the new Booking move picker. (3) Preferred pairing does not order the admin finder or Reassign suggestions (pill only, comment says 'marked, not lifted') although US-01.4.2, US-13.6.4 and US-01.3.5 now say tier and preferred pairing order the list; how they combine is an undecided assumed reading, so a ruling is needed first, and the change could alter the on-screen order in the illness-reassignment beat and Find available screenshots (check docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md). OQ-102 (names) is open, so the Tier 1 to 4 labels are acceptable until AA picks names (one-line edit in TIER_LABELS). A PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed only if the seed changes (for example a seeded movable Booking).

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: The epic hinges on one missing thing: a single matching / review-and-merge screen with an unmatched queue. Today intake is (a) HL7/FHIR message simulation that auto-applies (store/integrationActions.ts applyEffect, commented 'Interim until Phase 33') and (b) a Surgeon PDFs tab that ingests directly onto an ACTIVE List. The prototype itself says the in-scope download 'arrives in a later build' (DemoIntegrations.tsx:131, DemoControlPanel S1 text), so no hidden implementation exists. Verifier changes: FT-02.6 and US-02.6.1 regraded Missing to Contradicts, because the no-NHI scenario is handled by the opposite design (provisional 'NHI pending' patient and Booking: store/intake.ts:97-127, seed/bookings.ts:846-858, shared/format.ts:82-90) that the catalogue now forbids; US-02.2.1 regraded Contradicts to Partial (its AC is met; gaps are unbuilt, not wrong); FT-02.2 kept Contradicts but is borderline. Removing the provisional path touches: upsertPatient createdProvisional, nhiBadge, the seeded provisional patient PAT.provisional / provisionalNoNhi Booking (and its scenario jump entry in seed/index.ts:831), ReviewScreen.tsx:261 and ListDetailView.tsx:82 fallbacks, and the 'Ingest PDF row' trigger that is seed-scoped to that patient; PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped. Stub work needs a new Stub record outside Bookings on a non-NHI id, displayed in admin Day/Review/Draft drawers and mobile/web/PWA Lists. Dependencies: US-02.5.2/02.5.4/02.5.5 (day move as cancel plus new Booking, edits until AUTHORISED, change history with source), US-02.1.2/02.1.3 (matching, differences), US-11.1.2/11.1.4/11.1.5 (mandatory NHI), EP-14 (Messages and Feed config tabs are Future scope; FEED-CPH outside scope), US-13.4.1/13.6.1/13.8.2 (contact emails exist; List-move notification offer missing), US-01.6.1 (hospitalRow Draft List origin exists, unused). Open questions that could move grades: OQ-109 (which two hospitals), OQ-13 (format), OQ-124, OQ-127/OQ-128 (which room email). Demo guide: S1 beat 1 (Fire hospital message S12 creates a Booking) is the exact auto-apply behaviour now contradicted; S4 beats using MSG-CPH-2001 dead-letter and MSG-STG-1002 depend on the message monitor (Future scope). New demo controls proposed, shown only on the matching screen: 'Receive hospital list' per hospital, 'Receive surgeon PDF / updated PDF', and a no-NHI row variant with 'Add NHI'.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: EP-03 events (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1, US-03.7.2) are structurally absent: the interim post-op addendum (addPostOpAddendum, marked INTERIM until Phase 38b/39) models the opposite of the catalogue, a Booking on a List instead of an element on the Procedure. Closing them needs one new domain entity (event: time|fixedFee|additionalInvoice|credit, own date/time, invoice tick, own billable party, reviewed flag), store actions, event UI in the Booking detail on mobile, web and admin, an event review step, a standalone 'next billing run' that bundles by billable party (Invoice.kind needs additional and credit), and a PERSIST_VERSION bump. The three items should be planned as one build; sizing them separately overstates the total. Dependencies: US-03.1.6 (past Procedures; billed Lists leave the anaesthetist's views at authorise, so a past-Procedure entry point needs a different view), US-08.6.1/08.6.3/08.6.5, FT-11.2, US-05.5.2 and OQ-12 (parked), FT-04.3 (step rail, working direction only), US-08.4.6/OQ-130 (invoice description). US-03.6.1's new minimum (Contract required, times only for time-priced Contracts, modifier explanation, RVG optional) rewrites validateBookingForBilling and needs a modifier-explanation field; it interacts with the add-booking form (no Contract chosen there; Contract is office-only in EditBillingSetupSheet). It also shows hospital/approval references only as a free-text billingReference, with no insurer approval number. US-03.1.9 needs separate as-received rooms and hospital descriptions plus an invoice description on the Procedure and a Contract summary; correction to the first review: the S14 hospital message does not touch the description at all (only time and note), and the overwrite is in the PDF-row ingest. US-03.1.4 is a principle and matches. Demo script impact: S4 Beat 2 (post-op addendum, docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md ~543-553) would be rewritten; the S1 mark-complete beat changes with the new completion rules; S3 billing beats are unaffected unless events join the invoice list.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: EP-04 in scope is graded against the original-RFP Contract model the prototype still implements: Type 1/2/3 Contracts, a protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct insurer (seeded Procedures point at them), billingRoute plus an optional governingContractId on the Procedure, one editable From/To date pair, and an unfiltered Contract select with a blank 'None (default pricing)' option in EditBillingSetupSheet. Almost every item therefore Contradicts rather than Missing; only US-04.3.4 is Partial. Verification confirmed all eight reviewer verdicts; the only correction is that the Contract edit sheet can already create an individual-anaesthetist-scoped Contract (US-04.2.14), though none is seeded or filtered by owner. Most of the work is shared: one XL rework of the Contract model (header plus lines, practitioner-ID holders, AA-held No contract (RVG), dated versions) across domain/types.ts, seed/contracts.ts, store/contractActions.ts, mastersActions.ts, billing/contracts.ts and invoiceBuild.ts, then a new filtered, ordered, searchable picker with step rail; per-item sizes overlap and must not be summed. PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped. Dependencies: US-04.1.x (holders, AA code, staged Contract changes US-04.1.6), US-04.3.5 (lock at authorisation), US-04.3.6, EP-05 pricing (line rate, discount, units), EP-06 prepayment (a prepaid Contract flag replacing the Procedure patientPaymentCategory trigger), US-11.2.2 (payer on the Booking replacing billingRoute), US-03.4.1 (anaesthetist may change the Contract) and OQ-117 (fixed prices block anaesthetist override). FT-04.2, US-04.2.10 and US-04.2.14 rest on OQ-131 and FT-04.3's step rail is a guess, so only the whole-Contract-versions reading should be built if the team accepts it. Demo-guide impact: S1 to S5 and the 'Beat 4: contract effective-dating' beat, plus the registry.ts COS ACC date-out trigger (~374-384), rely on hospital default Type 1 Contracts and fallback; reworking defaults, versions or the picker changes those beats, seeded invoices and demoScenarios tests.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: US-05.5.2 is almost wholly a consumer of the event framework (US-03.7.1 pre/post-op events, US-03.7.2 billing an event, OQ-63, OQ-121; catch-up phase 39b). Once events exist, this story adds only a small seed of preconfigured ACC pre-op event presets (CS250, CS260, CS70, flagged to be confirmed because OQ-12 part 1 is open) plus removing or rewording the 'Ancillary fixed amount' caption that names ACC pre-op. No fixed-fee Contract is needed (OQ-12 part 2 answered 28 October). Dependencies: EP-03 events, EP-11 billable party, and next-run billing and bundling (the billing run currently fires on authoriseList, so event invoicing in the next run needs a run concept). Whether the generic 'Ancillary fixed amount' line survives for other uses is a separate question; only its ACC pre-op example wording is superseded. No scripted S1 to S5 beat was found that uses an ACC pre-op line, so demo-guide impact is expected to be low. The story's screenshots depict the superseded flat-fee model.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations: The central missing structure is the AA Holding account. It is a creditor in the payables mirror, never paid, that receives prepayments and transfers them to the anaesthetist who did the List. That one change closes FT-06.3 and US-06.5.1 and removes the payee-repoint seam on a move (US-06.5.4). The second missing structure is a credit note and refund document kind: Invoice.kind is only standard|prePayment, and cancelBooking and editProcedure touch no invoice. That closes US-06.5.2 and US-06.3.7 and is also needed by US-02.5.3 and the sent-or-paid half of US-06.3.5. Build order: holding account and transfer pair (with the US-06.4.1 / OQ-125 release trigger), then credit/refund engine plus cancel hook (US-06.5.2), then the Contract prepaid flag and change handler (US-06.2.1, US-06.3.5, US-06.3.7). The prototype keys prepayment on the Procedure's patientPaymentCategory (route billableParty plus selfFundedPrepayment) rather than a Contract-level prepaid flag, so US-06.3.5 and US-06.3.7 depend on the flag model from the prepayment-requirement and contract features. What already matches: a move re-triggers no prepayment or invoice calculation (US-06.3.5 AC2), and an unpaid prepayment only warns without blocking. Prepayment-related behaviour in the demo is stale under the current catalogue: the paid seed Booking (Fri 24 PM, INV0001/BC0001) pays through to the anaesthetist, and the balance run nets the deposit off the final invoice, where US-06.4.1 says a prepaid Procedure is left off the final invoice. Demo-script impact: S4 Beat 1 (Fri 24 prepayment warning) and S3 (payment received, then payable released) change, because a prepayment would land in the holding account and release only on List authorisation. S1, S2 and S5 are unaffected. The seed and PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped for the holding account and any seeded credit or refund. OQ-120 (does the prepayment invoice name the anaesthetist) is open and leans to not naming. The prototype's InvoiceDocument names the anaesthetist, which is minor to revisit once AA answers.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: US-07.2.2 depends on stories in other epics, so its closure is largely a consequence of them: US-03.1.9 (source text, then Contract, then RVG code), US-03.6.3 (a Procedure flagged for the office; no field or UI exists), US-11.2.2 and US-11.2.4 (a Booking-level payer and the under-18 payer warning; today the payer is a per-Procedure billablePartyId), and US-11.4.3 / US-13.7.1 (insurer and approval number on the Booking plus the insured-without-approval warning; absent from the domain model). The review table (ReviewScreen.tsx) needs restructuring to Booking rows with nested per-Procedure lines, a way to open or edit a Booking from the review (none today), and an approve/correct affordance. The warning mechanism (useListWarnings and WarningTriangle on each row) is the natural home for the child-payer and missing-approval warnings. Authorise is never gated, which matches 'warns, without blocking'. Seed data and PERSIST_VERSION would change with new Booking fields, and the S1 to S5 demo beats that include the office review would change. The seeded guardian-pays-for-a-minor Booking (Grace Park) is the natural demo case for the child-payer warning.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: FT-08.6 and stories 08.6.1, 08.6.3 and 08.6.5 are all status Verify (3), graded against the text as written. OQ-97 (part credit) is unresolved. The prototype has no event element on Procedures, no ledger receivable/payable pair, no free-form invoice, no credit note and no negative payable; Invoice.kind is only standard|prePayment with no parent-invoice link. The single related feature, 'Add post-op event' (addPostOpAddendum, store/bookingActions.ts:199), builds a separate Booking on a new List in a free session and bills it by Contract/RVG through the List cycle. That is an older reading, so FT-08.6 and US-08.6.1 are Contradicts, not Partial. The code comments and demo script S3 beat 2 (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md:543-553) call it interim until the additional-invoice phases. Dependencies: ledger and invoice pair model (US-08.3.1), invoice numbering (US-08.4.3), Event element on Procedures (FT-03.7, US-03.7.2), standard event review (OQ-63), next-run bundling (OQ-121), Xero pair mirroring (EP-09), negative-invoice netting in the payment run (US-10.2.5, US-08.6.2), prepayment cancel refund (US-06.5.2) and BCTI counting (bcti.ts:122). Sibling US-08.6.2 (credit in full then rebill) shares the same foundation. Replacing the addendum means rewriting S3 Beat 2 and the 'Stage post-op scenario' trigger, the store/postOpAddendum tests, and bumping PERSIST_VERSION. Suggest one L foundation phase (invoice kinds, parent links, ledger pair, events) before the story phases.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: Only FT-10.2 was graded here. Its authorise-on-receipt half (US-10.2.1, partial payments, no AA fee netting) matches. The gap is a structural change of who pays: disbursement must move out of the AA product (Admin Billing monitor 'Run payables', payablesActions.ts, and the Xero simulator's disbursePayable call) into the simulated Xero, with a new ACCPAY-paid detection handler (webhook plus poll, idempotent, audited with source system) that mirrors receivePayment. US-09.2.4 (Detect disbursement), US-10.2.7 (weekly payment cycle) and US-10.2.6 (BCTI approval) share this store and simulator surface, so they should reuse one 'Xero payables run' trigger and one Disbursement record rather than adding another payout path. Demo guide impact: S3 Beat 3 (narration 'AA pays' becomes 'Xero pays') and S4 Beat 5 (partial payment, two payables runs). Expected outcomes (payable authorises exactly what arrived, total paid equals invoice total, no double pay) are preserved. A PERSIST_VERSION bump is likely needed only if the Disbursement shape gains a source field. payablesActions, AccountsScreen and xeroNhi tests call disbursePayable directly and would need updating.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Structural changes. (1) FT-11.2 is a re-model: move the payer from Procedure.billablePartyId to the Booking (defaulting to the patient, editable by office and anaesthetist) and let the Contract decide the counterparty. This needs the holder 'is billed' setting (US-04.1.5), No contract (RVG) (US-04.3.3) and the anaesthetist's own Contract (US-04.2.14), so it depends on EP-04 phases. The BillingRoute enum with its insurer route, in invoiceBuild.ts, validateBookingForBilling.ts, EditBillingSetupSheet.tsx and Insurer.acceptsDirectClaims, is the legacy reading and ripples into invoice build, Xero handoff and the Review screen. (2) NHI-mandatory (US-11.1.1, 11.1.4, 11.1.5) must be built together with the EP-02 unmatched queue (US-02.1.4) and stubs (FT-02.6, US-02.6.1). Remove the provisional-patient path in store/intake.ts (createdProvisional), ingestPdfRow, the integration feed path (integrationActions.ts:160), ManualBookingForm (canSave must require the NHI), and the 'NHI pending' text in format.ts, ListDetailView.tsx and ReviewScreen.tsx. Rework the seed's provisional patient and PDF-pathway scenario (seed/patients.ts, seed/index.ts:830, seed/bookings.ts:855) into a waiting intake row, and bump PERSIST_VERSION. The Data quality tab only covers ethnicity today, so the waiting-NHI view is a new surface (or a new section of the unmatched queue). (3) US-11.4.3 needs an approval-number field on the Booking/Procedure, a new rule in the warnings registry (provisional kind/strength per US-13.7.1), anaesthetist edit rights, and removal of the insurer master list and 'accepts direct claims' coupling (shared with FT-11.2). (4) OQ-114 (invoice delivery output flag on holders) and OQ-127 (room versus surgeon PA address for the missing-NHI email) are unresolved; both affect only a text/recipient detail. Several items are Verify status resting on OQ-118, answered 4 Nov by Donald only (not yet seen by Vanessa or Ben), so build risk is low-moderate. Demo guide impact: the PDF pathway story (Okafor 27 Jul row, provisional 'NHI pending' patient), the guardian-payer beat (Park, minor) and any insured-reimbursement beat would change. I did not audit docs/demo-guide line by line.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: Largest gaps: US-12.1.4 (no bank details anywhere; HPI CPN still optional so it needs mandatory validation in add and edit, bank fields on the sheets and record page, audit labels, bank values in the seed for all 13 anaesthetists (HPI CPNs are already seeded), and a PERSIST_VERSION bump from 25), US-12.2.1 (remove ageing everywhere and add a link from each line to its Booking), and US-12.2.2 (rebase the GST report on disbursements, monthly only, add download/email/print). Ageing removal is one change touching mobile AgeChip and the headline total, web Accounts Overdue table and tab name, the dashboard Receivables aging panel (US-12.2.3), and the selectors (bucketForAgingDays, receivablesAgingFor); do these in one phase. Replace the dashboard ageing panel with an owed / collected / paid out position (US-08.3.5). The gstPeriod profile field (Bi-monthly, Six-monthly; admin record, add/edit forms, Whitaker seeded six-monthly) is unnecessary under a monthly report and is also not among the profile settings FT-12.1 lists. Priority tier is another extra on the admin record (office-only, fine). Dependencies: US-10.1.2 (Disbursement records and case.disbursedAtISO already exist in the billing mirror; the GST of a payment comes from the linked invoice/receipt as Disbursement has no GST), US-08.3.1/08.3.2/08.3.5, US-05.2.7, US-13.6.3/13.6.4 (pairings already built, admin-only). Unit rate and pairings need no work; there is no anaesthetist-facing profile screen, which the catalogue does not require. OQ-123 (billing-practice reporting) is unanswered; nothing is demonstrably missing, only a future data hook. Demo-guide impact: S3 Beat 3 (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md around L464-480) says the row leaves 'Overdue', Beat 4 (~L504) discusses GST activity, and the navigation table (~L55-67) names these tabs; all change with the rename and rebase. Admin screenshots need seeded bank details.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: Core structural change: Surgeon.roomId (single) becomes a many-to-many surgeon-room link (OQ-128 answered 4 Nov by Donald for the build). This ripples to surgeonsInRoom, SurgeonFields and SurgeonEditSheet (multi-select), SurgeonProfile (several room cards), the Surgeons table Room column, seed (cast.ts, specialistDirectory.ts, which currently gives a two-practice surgeon the smaller room only), a PERSIST_VERSION bump, surgeon master/action tests and screenshot captures. Separately, room contactEmail must become optional (cleanRoomFields currently refuses blank; the seed injects reception@ placeholders), and the booking update email drafter (US-02.3.3) and missing-NHI email (US-11.1.5) must tolerate an empty To. Practice manager/PA contacts (US-13.6.5) are a new child entity; OQ-127 leaves it open whether it hangs on the room or the surgeon, so model it as a contact with an optional room or surgeon owner. Open questions OQ-126 (address book/specialty search/street address), OQ-127 (which room's contacts apply to a multi-room Booking) and OQ-129 (surgeons without HPI CPN; the cutover load US-13.4.3 depends on it) make parts speculative; grades follow the written text, and the one-room model and mandatory room email are the only implemented behaviours now contradicted. Sequencing: do the multi-room/optional-email model change in one phase first (covers FT-13.6, US-13.6.1, most of US-13.6.2), then PA contacts. The demo guide beats that show a single room card on a surgeon profile would change slightly. No demo trigger needed: all of it is direct admin UI. Verification changed FT-13.6 and US-13.6.2 from Partial to Contradicts; US-13.6.1 and US-13.6.5 are upheld.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: EP-14 is mostly a parent of FT-14.1 to FT-14.6 (Future Work lane), but its body states three rules of its own: the first-release sync of both integrated hospitals into the matching screen, the NHI lookup being in scope, and the adapter and configuration-matrix design. The prototype's HL7/FHIR pipeline is already badged Future scope (catch-up Phase 14, to be demoted in Phase 34), so the Future-lane message is in place. The real gap is structural and sits in EP-02: there is no hospital download or matching screen (FT-02.1, US-02.1.5, Phase 33). Until then, integrationActions applyEffect writes hospital messages directly as Bookings onto Dr Souter's existing ACTIVE List. The first-release sync depends on that screen being built and on those messages being rerouted into it, which is also where the OQ-118 stub-at-intake question interacts. OQ-109 part 1 (St George's and Southern Cross vs Forte) is unresolved, so feed names may change, and part 2 is only assumed (4 Nov, not yet seen by AA). Demo impact: the S1 beat (MSG-STG-1001 lands Sarah Mitchell on Souter's Tue 28 Jul AM List) would gain an office review-and-merge step, and the 'Fire hospital message' triggers would change. S4's Christchurch Public mapping-fix beat stays but is framed as Future. The NHI lookup beat (S2) is unaffected.

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: All four EP-15 items are cross-cutting and Proposed. Gaps map onto existing plan phases (all unbuilt): 43 (scale and privacy: in-memory full-scale dataset with timings, restricted raw-payload view, NHI leak scan, synthetic-data badge) for US-15.0.4 and US-15.0.6; 43a (sign-in, ease of use, point-of-need help, first-run hint) for US-15.0.1. US-15.0.2 Matches; web document download/email/print belongs to US-03.1.4 and US-12.2.2. Cross-item tension: US-15.0.1's Note ("anaesthetists see none of the Contract complexity") is Proposed and now yields to Confirmed US-03.1.2 and US-03.1.9, which require the Contract on anaesthetist screens; the prototype currently shows route chip plus Contract/insurer/payer context to anaesthetists, so 43a must keep the Contract but can drop the route chip. A scale loader must bypass persistence (5 MB budget), so no PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed. The raw-payload view ties to US-14.5.1 (dead-lettered HL7) and US-09.3.1 (already matches). Demo-guide impact: Xero beat and integration dead-letter beat gain a restricted-raw-view step; a scale beat would be new. A synthetic-data badge touches the shell harness bar and the PWA More tab.

items.summary: Epic's own model (rolling canvas, AM/PM Slot per anaesthetist, free by default, List placed in a Slot, Draft List with no anaesthetist, 'slot' never in UI) is built; real gaps sit in children US-01.5.2, 01.5.4, 01.6.3, 01.4.7.
items.requirement_says: Rolling schedule; every active anaesthetist has AM+PM Slot daily (free by default); active List sits in one Slot with one surgeon, anaesthetist, hospital; Draft List = no anaesthetist; the word 'slot' never shown; reference data by identity.
items.prototype_does: Slots stored for every active anaesthetist/day/session across the horizon; one List per Slot; DRAFT Lists with no anaesthetist/slot; UI says session/Draft List; hospital+surgeon required on every List.
evidence: searched: user-visible strings containing 'slot' in apps/shared/store/domain -> none (actionLabels.ts:78 says none)
items.verify_note: Re-read canvas.ts and grepped for user-facing 'slot' copy; none. Epic body states its own rules but the prototype satisfies them. The one epic-level tension is the seeded List on an Unavailable session (graded under US-01.5.2), not the model itself.
items.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists

items.summary: Canvas generated at seed, rolled forward on clock day change, horizon editable in months (1 to 24) with extend/trim; status Proposed but behaviour matches the text.
items.requirement_says: Scheduling Engine pre-generates Schedule/Day/Anaesthetist/Slot structure across a rolling horizon (4 months default, any number of months).

items.summary: Owner-only submit and the office's Booking move work, but a prepaid Booking's payable goes to the anaesthetist on the List, not an AA Holding account, so a move leaves it with the wrong person; the anaesthetist-led move to a new List does not exist (status Verify).
items.requirement_says: Whoever submits a List did all its procedures; a Booking done by another anaesthetist is moved to that anaesthetist's List (even a single-Booking List). Unprepaid: payable follows the Booking to the doer. Prepaid: payable is the AA Holding account and does not move, the doer is paid from it at settlement; nothing is recalculated or re-triggered on the move.
items.prototype_does: submitList is owner-only and needs every non-cancelled Booking completed; anaesthetists cannot edit another's List. The office can move one Booking to any non-AUTHORISED List (MoveBookingFlow to reassignBooking), which touches no prepayment or invoice. The Xero handoff derives the ACCPAY payee from the Booking's List's anaesthetist at handoff time, so an unprepaid Booking moved before handoff is paid to the new anaesthetist. A prepayment invoice also hands off at once with a payable to the List's anaesthetist (raisePreProcedureInvoice then handoffCasesForBooking); there is no AA Holding creditor and no settlement transfer, and an already-created accPay keeps its anaesthetistId after a move (code comments mark a 'Phase 41 seam').
missing_or_wrong: No AA Holding payable: a prepaid Booking's ACCPAY is created for the anaesthetist on the List at handoff and never repointed, so after a move A stays the payee and B, who did the work, is not paid from it (contradicts AC 3 and AC 4). The prepayment itself is still the old deposit/self-funded model rather than the Contract-flagged full-amount prepayment of EP-06.
An already-handed-off unprepaid ACCPAY is not repointed when the Booking later moves (payee fixed at handoff).

An anaesthetist cannot move a Booking to a colleague as a new List: reassignBooking refuses anaesthetists unless both Lists are their own (notOwnList), the older reading. Only the office path produces 'Booking ends up on B's List' (see US-01.4.7).
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/xeroHandoff.ts:194-198,265-278 (payee = List's anaesthetist at handoff; accPay.anaesthetistId fixed)
aa-prototype/src/store/slotActions.ts:458-461 and aa-prototype/src/store/listMoveActions.ts:141-142 ('PHASE 41 SEAM' payee repoint not built)

items.title: The List's anaesthetist did its procedures

items.summary: An anaesthetist cannot move a single Booking in either app; only whole-List moves exist for anaesthetists, and the only Booking-level move is the office's MoveBookingFlow, which moves into existing Lists, the opposite of the new rule.
items.requirement_says: An anaesthetist can move one Booking from one of their Lists to a colleague free in that Slot, found by scrolling free colleagues (availability only) or a type-ahead name search. The move creates a new List in the receiver's Slot holding the Booking, never an existing List; unavailable or on-leave receivers are not offered until they set themselves available. The mover may optionally notify the admin pool or raise the update email; no not-preferred warning; the payable follows the Booking unless prepaid (AA Holding stays).
items.prototype_does: Nothing on the anaesthetist side. BookingDetailBody and the mobile/web Booking screens have no move action; 'Move this List' (MoveListSheet) moves the whole List. NotificationKind is only 'listMoved' (types.ts:476 comment anticipates Phase 32a's single Booking).
missing_or_wrong: No anaesthetist-side 'Move this Booking' action on Booking detail (mobile and web)
No receiver picker (free colleagues in that Slot by availability alone) with a type-ahead name search
No store action that creates a new List in the receiver's open Slot to hold the one Booking; receivers already holding a List in that Slot must not be offered

items.summary: The NHI is shown on each Booking (the only written acceptance criterion is met), but the prototype treats the NHI as optional ('NHI pending', provisional patients), where the story now says it is mandatory.
items.requirement_says: The anaesthetist sees the patient's NHI on each Booking in their app; the NHI is mandatory, so a Booking's patient always has one (never sent to Xero).
items.prototype_does: BookingDetailBody and list rows show the NHI via nhiBadge; all seeded patients have one. But Patient.nhi is optional, nhiBadge returns 'NHI pending' for blank, ManualBookingForm sends an NHI only when non-blank and intake creates a provisional patient without one.
missing_or_wrong: Patient.nhi optional, documented as 'where available' (types.ts:160-175)
'NHI pending' fallback (format.ts:87-93) and web list fallback
Manual add booking and intake allow no NHI and create a provisional record (store/intake.ts:60-118; ManualBookingForm.tsx:113)
No mandatory validation on add booking
items.verify_note: Re-read the story: its single AC is satisfied, but the body and 16/19 Oct notes make the NHI mandatory with no blank, which the prototype's 'NHI pending' and provisional patients contradict. Confidence medium because some of the rework belongs to EP-02 intake and EP-11 rather than this story.
items.title: Anaesthetist sees the patient's NHI

items.summary: No name or NHI search anywhere; web Lists has a From/To date range that reaches back about 14 days; billed Lists are hidden everywhere.
items.requirement_says: Find past work mainly by patient name (loose), also NHI and date (jump to a day and drill in); submitted Lists stay on main view until authorised; authorised ones found via search.
items.prototype_does: Web ListsScreen From/To native date inputs (default today to +28d, can be set to past dates inside the 14-day past horizon) and drill into a List; mobile Lists has only Week/Month/To-Do/Done filters; Submitted/Authorised Lists stay until billedAtISO set, then vanish from every list view; no search.
missing_or_wrong: No search by name or NHI (two of three acceptance criteria)
Date criterion only partly met: web range filter only, no mobile date picker, data only 14 days back
Billed/invoiced Bookings unreachable by the anaesthetist, so no 'what did I enter' view of an invoiced Booking
Authorised-but-unbilled Lists are not found via search (there is none)
evidence: searched: search|findBooking in apps/mobile apps/web -> only AvailabilityGrid colleague filter
items.verify_note: Reviewer said no date picker; ListsScreen has From/To date inputs that can jump to a past day and drill into its List, so the Date criterion is partly present on web. Name/NHI and billed visibility remain missing, so Partial rather than Missing.
items.title: Find past work and old invoices

items.summary: No Booking search by NHI or patient name in either anaesthetist app.
items.requirement_says: Search by NHI or partial name returns the patient's Bookings, and from a Booking its Procedures.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. NHI Look up in ManualBookingForm is for new bookings; only search box is the colleague filter on web Find cover.
missing_or_wrong: Search input and results screen on mobile and web
Loose partial-name match over own past Bookings incl. invoiced ones
NHI exact match
evidence: searched: search|nhi lookup in apps/mobile apps/web shared -> ManualBookingForm lookupNhi (new booking) and AvailabilityGrid name filter only
items.verify_note: Grepped search/filter across apps and shared; no patient or booking search. Agreed status so searched hard; the NHI lookup is a different function (simulated Digital Services Hub on create).
items.title: Search Bookings by NHI or patient name

items.summary: Booking shows a 'Prepayment received' banner once paid, never the prepaid amount, nothing at unit capture.
items.requirement_says: On a prepaid Booking the anaesthetist sees the prepaid amount (price on the issued prepayment invoice, from the prepaid Contract line) when opening it and when recording units.
items.prototype_does: Banner 'Prepayment received. The prepayment invoice has been paid.' only when status is paid; outstanding/required show only a warning row; prepaymentDetail (full | split deposit) exists but no amount is displayed; anaesthetist sees no money.
missing_or_wrong: Prepaid amount not shown on the Booking
Not shown at units capture
Amount source is old deposit/estimate on the Procedure, not the prepaid Contract line (US-04.2.14)
items.verify_note: Single acceptance criterion (amount shown) is unmet; prepaid indicator exists, so Partial not Missing. Agreed status so re-checked.
items.title: See the prepaid amount on the Booking

items.summary: The Booking shows one operation description, a route/contract context line and the RVG code, but there is no as-received rooms vs hospital wording, no Contract summary (holder, who is invoiced, pricing basis and figure), no invoice description and no 'still to choose' marking.
items.requirement_says: Each Procedure shows (1) the rooms' and hospital's descriptions as received, (2) its Contract: name, holder, who is invoiced, pricing basis and figure ('Fixed $2,400', '10% off RVG'), (3) RVG code where the Contract prices from RVG; plus the invoice description that will print (rooms' text, replaced by hospital's, replaced by Contract line's; admin-editable). Both apps show it; empty parts marked 'still to choose'; fuller hospital wording kept and shown too.
items.prototype_does: Procedure has a single free-text description (header 'Operation to capture' when empty). BtmCaptureBlock shows a context line of route label plus contract name, insurer, billable party and billing reference joined by middots; the RVG code shows via ProcedureCodeCard in the shared body used by both apps. The hospital S14 update changes only time and note, never the description; a PDF-row re-ingest overwrites the single description. Invoice lines come from line descriptions, not a booking invoice description.
missing_or_wrong: MISSING: separate rooms and hospital descriptions kept as received; only one description field exists (domain/types.ts Procedure.description), so the hospital's fuller wording is never kept or shown
WRONG (minor): ingestPdfRow overwrites the one description on update (store/integrationActions.ts:479-482), losing the earlier wording instead of keeping both
MISSING: Contract summary beyond the name: no holder, no 'who is invoiced', no pricing basis and figure (Fixed $x, % off RVG, RVG)
MISSING: invoice description and its default chain (rooms, hospital, Contract line) with admin edit (OQ-130 unresolved)
MISSING: explicit 'still to choose' marking for unset Contract or RVG code (only 'Route not set' and 'Operation to capture' placeholders)
MISSING: Contract is set only in the office EditBillingSetupSheet; no labelled Contract part for the anaesthetist
Related: FT-04.3 step-rail picker not built
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/integrationActions.ts:225-231 (S14 patches time and note only), :479-482 (PDF update overwrites description)
searched: invoiceDescription|roomsDescription|hospitalDescription|asReceived|still to choose in src -> none
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Fire hospital message' / 'Replay hospital message' (integrations and mobile lists) can deliver hospital wording; the booking screen would need to show both texts, and the S14 canned message would need to carry a fuller description.
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld, evidence corrected: the reviewer said the hospital S14 update overwrites the description via editProcedure at integrationActions.ts:479-480. That line is the PDF-row ingest; the S14 path (:225-231) patches only scheduledTime and notes, so hospital wording never reaches the description at all. Added the PDF overwrite as a minor wrong behaviour and kept the rest. No code contradicts the new design badly enough to move this to Contradicts.
items.title: Booking descriptions and Contract shown together

items.summary: Additional procedures never carry modifier units; catalogue rule splits modifiers across procedures when total exceeds 4. Base-on-primary is right.
items.requirement_says: Exactly one primary per Booking; base units, and modifiers under the US-05.3.1 rule (all on primary if total <= 4, else equal share with remainder to primary), anchor to it.
items.prototype_does: splitBillingUnits gives an additional procedure time units only; B and M steppers and ASA/modifier chips are disabled with 'Not charged on an additional procedure'; note says base and modifier units stay on the first procedure. feeFor prices each procedure in isolation. isAdditional flag, not isPrimary.
missing_or_wrong: No modifier split above 4 units (needs Booking-level computation; 7 over 3 = 3/2/2)
UI caption/note encode the old RFP rule
No isPrimary flag or exactly-one invariant; copyCard yields a Booking with no primary (see FT-03.2)
Type 3 second-procedure pricing keyed by ordinal, not Contract multi-procedure rule
items.verify_note: Read US-05.3.1 and fee.ts; wrong behaviour confirmed. Added the copyCard no-primary point.
items.title: One primary Procedure

items.summary: Primary is set at creation (first Procedure) but nobody can change which is primary; no reorder or make-primary action.
items.requirement_says: Admin, anaesthetist or an inbound source can set or change the primary Procedure while the Booking is editable.
items.prototype_does: createBooking (office, anaesthetist, hospital message) makes the first Procedure primary (isAdditional false); additional ones can only be added or removed; removeProcedure refuses the first.
missing_or_wrong: No make-primary / reorder action for anaesthetist or admin
Inbound feed cannot name or change the primary after creation
Primary not shown first by designation (only by creation order)
Rule that an ACC pre-op assessment is never primary not modelled
items.verify_note: Reviewer's own evidence (FT-03.2 Matches) shows a primary is set at creation by any actor, so the 'set' half exists; only 'change' is missing. Partial.
items.title: Anyone with edit rights can set the primary

items.summary: Anaesthetist and office can add further Procedures to a Booking, but the new Procedure silently inherits the first Procedure's Contract; the anaesthetist has no way to select its own Contract and the office select is unfiltered.
items.requirement_says: An anaesthetist or admin can add further Procedures to a Booking; each selects its own Contract (US-04.3.1).
items.prototype_does: 'Add another procedure' (shown when canCapture: DRAFT for anaesthetist, DRAFT or SUBMITTED for office, not once the Booking is marked complete) calls addProcedure: new isAdditional Procedure inherits route, insurer, billable party, category and governingContractId from the first Procedure; own code card, times, lines; bills time units only. 'Copy booking' is separate. Only the office can change a Procedure's governing contract (EditBillingSetupSheet, all contracts, unfiltered).
missing_or_wrong: Each additional Procedure should select its own Contract; prototype copies the first Procedure's contract and gives the anaesthetist no Contract control
Office contract select lists every Contract (not those set against the procedure, US-04.3.2)
Additional Procedure hard-wired 'time units only' (domain rule; Contract-driven multi-procedure rules owned by other epics)
items.verify_note: Confirmed inheritance in addProcedure and that EditBillingSetupSheet is mounted only via OfficeBillingSetup. Considered Contradicts (inherit vs select own) but nothing implemented is wrong, only the per-procedure pick is absent for anaesthetists, so Partial holds. Added that the button disappears once the Booking is completed.
items.title: Add additional Procedures

items.summary: RVG type-ahead picker with code, description and base units exists, but completion still demands an RVG code, ranged bases are clamped and an out-of-range choice blocks completion, none of which the story allows; also no Contract-line default, no Contract-change reset and no out-of-range warning.
items.requirement_says: On an RVG Contract the anaesthetist picks the RVG code by type-ahead (code, short description, base units per row). The code is optional (not needed on a fixed price), defaults from the Contract line, and sets starting base units (or the line's own); modifier units start at 0 plus any system-applied modifier. Changing the Contract resets price/rate/discount/starting units. Ranged codes show the range and the anaesthetist picks any value; out of range is accepted and raises an after-procedure warning for the office, never blocked.
items.prototype_does: CodePickerSheet searches `rvgCodes` by code/description, grouped by anatomicalSite, rows showing 'B n' or 'B min to max'. Picking a code clears baseUnitsSelected/baseUnitsCaptured so base re-seeds. Range codes get a stepper clamped to min..max (ProcedureCodeCard RangeUnitsRow). validateBookingForBilling fails completion when no RVG code and no non-RVG line exist, and when a ranged code's baseUnitsSelected is undefined or outside min..max. The B/T/M steppers in UnitsCard can set any manual value (floor 0), but no warning is raised (the only warning rule is prepaymentUnpaid). Contract is changed only in the office EditBillingSetupSheet; changing it resets nothing. No Contract-line entity or default RVG code exists.
missing_or_wrong: CONTRADICTS optional RVG: validator (validateBookingForBilling.ts:130-132) fails a procedure with no RVG code and no non-RVG line, so a fixed-price Contract without a code cannot be completed
CONTRADICTS never-blocked range rule: the UI clamps the ranged base value to min..max and validator L153-163 fails completion when it is unset or out of range; the story accepts any value
No after-procedure warning for out-of-range base units (domain/warnings/rules holds only prepaymentUnpaid; US-13.7.1 not built)
No Contract-line default RVG code and no line-stated base units (Contract has only Type 1/2/3 plus ContractPrice rows)
No reset of price/rate/discount/starting units on Contract change (EditBillingSetupSheet just patches governingContractId); the anaesthetist cannot change the Contract (US-03.4.1)
Picker is not shown conditionally for RVG-priced Contracts and is not available as optional on fixed-price ones
Picker grouping is by anatomicalSite; the story's captions say RVG body headings are the intended grouping

Modifier units start from the ASA seed (e.g. ASA III +3), whereas the story says they start at 0 plus any system-applied modifier; whether the ASA seed counts as system-applied is tied to OQ-95 and US-03.3.4, so treat as a check not a firm gap
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/bookingActions.ts (governingContractId only copied to additional procedures)
items.verify_note: Opened the validator and confirmed both contradictions at the cited lines (RVG-or-line requirement; range clamp/fail). Confirmed the picker, EditBillingSetupSheet and warnings rules directory. Contradicts (not Partial) is right because the implemented range-blocking and required-code behaviours are the old reading. Softened the modifier-units point to a check (OQ-95). Size L kept because it spans the validator, a new warning rule, a Contract-reset and the Contract-line default, though the Contract-line entity itself belongs to US-04.2.4.
items.title: Choose the RVG code, with starting units

items.summary: Start now/Finish now stamps and time units work, but validation copy says 'handover' and times are mandatory on any RVG-coded Procedure even where the Contract fixes the price.
items.requirement_says: Record start and finish times (not handover); time units computed from them; time recording optional where the Contract fixes the price.
items.prototype_does: TimesCard 'Start now'/'Finish now' stamp the demo clock with nudges; stored as anaestheticStartISO/handoverISO; validator says 'Record the handover time.' and 'Handover must be after the anaesthetic start.'; times required whenever an RVG code is set, including fixed-price (Type 3) bookings that need an RVG code for price matching.
missing_or_wrong: User-visible validation messages say 'handover', which Greg ruled wrong (16 October)
Times mandatory on a fixed-price Contract (requirement: optional there)
Field and audit labels still 'handover'
items.verify_note: Two implemented behaviours differ from the requirement (visible 'handover' wording; forced times on fixed price), so Contradicts under the 'any wrong behaviour' rule. Core capture matches. Agreed status so re-checked.
items.title: Record anaesthetic start and finish times

items.summary: Itemised modifier controls exist, but the ASA grade seeds modifier units, no explanation is asked for, the age modifier is not pre-applied, and a base-included modifier is struck through rather than shown selected at 0 (status Verify with OQ-95 open: graded against the text as written).
items.requirement_says: Only the age modifier and any modifier the code's base units already include are pre-applied and shown selected (included ones as a removable-no pill at 0 units); nothing else is pre-filled whatever the ASA grade. The anaesthetist itemises every other modifier from the RVG table plus AA's own, giving a short explanation for each claimed; saving requires the explanation.
items.prototype_does: AsaCard sets asaClass, and resolveBtm adds that AS code's units to the M total even when no chip is picked (caption 'ASA III seeds +3 modifier units'). ModifierChips shows exclusive-band segmented controls (PA, A, OB) plus stacking chips (PA5, ASE, P1, AI1, PO1, PO2) from a 20-row demo-plausible table. A code absorbed by the base (P1 on hip, shoulder, spine) is disabled and struck through with a refusal reason. No explanation field anywhere.
missing_or_wrong: ASA grade seeds modifier units (fee.ts resolveBtm lines 78-85, AsaCard caption), contradicting 'nothing else pre-filled, whatever the ASA grade'; the ASA should be just one optional modifier choice
No per-modifier explanation and no save requirement for one (searched modifierNote|modifierExplanation|explanation in src: none)
Age modifier not pre-applied (see US-03.3.8)
Included modifier shown disabled and struck through rather than as a selected pill at 0 units; absorbsModifierCodes covers P1 on a few demo codes, not the full neurosurgery/spine sets
Modifier table is 20 demo values (MODIFIER_CODES), not the RVG table plus AA's own (US-05.1.5)
Exclusive-band rule (one code per band) is the prototype's own unconfirmed assumption
The M stepper in UnitsCard can override the total, bypassing itemisation
items.verify_note: Read fee.ts, AsaCard, ModifierChips and modifierCodes; all points real. Corrected the count of codes (20, not 19). OQ-95 does not rescue ASA seeding because the story text and its 'nothing else pre-filled' AC are explicit.
items.title: Choose optional modifiers, each with a short explanation

items.summary: The age modifier is never applied from the patient's date of birth; A1/A2 exist only as manually picked (removable) chips in an exclusive band, with one seeded Booking carrying A1 by hand (status Verify, OQ-95 boundaries open).
items.requirement_says: The system applies A1 or A2 from the patient's DOB (procedure date basis, to confirm), shows it already selected, and the anaesthetist can remove it; a patient outside the RVG age bands gets no age modifier.
items.prototype_does: The patient's age is displayed on the Booking (ageYears) but unused for pricing. A1 'Age extreme, very old' and A2 'very young' are manual segments in the 'A' exclusive band. Margaret Ellison's seed Booking has selectedModifierCodes ['A1'] hand-set, so that one Booking opens with A1 selected and removable.
missing_or_wrong: No age-to-modifier rule in domain or store (searched 'A1'|'A2' in src: only seed/bookings.ts:431 and modifierCodes.ts:27-28)
No pre-selection when a Procedure is opened for any other patient; nothing computes 'outside the bands adds nothing'
Band boundaries (1, 2, 70, 80) and H6b/P2 handling undefined (OQ-95), so any rule needs a stated demo reading
items.verify_note: Searched age/DOB and A1/A2 use: confirmed no automatic rule. Downgraded Missing to Partial because the A1/A2 modifier codes exist and are removable, and one seeded patient (age 72) already opens with A1 selected, so the removable-selected behaviour is demonstrable, just not derived from DOB. Size S stands (pure function plus a hook on opening/creating a Procedure).
items.title: Age modifier from the patient's age

items.summary: Anaesthetist cannot choose a Contract; can only change billing route/insurer/category while ACTIVE; no reset; no review flag. Status Verify.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist changes the Contract (and line) until AUTHORISED from a filtered list, no reason; price/rate/discount reset; audited and flagged at review; common case insurer to No contract (RVG) bills patient or named payer.
items.prototype_does: EditProcedureSheet offers operation, billing route, insurer, payment category, reference; governing Contract select only in office EditBillingSetupSheet; anaesthetist locked out once SUBMITTED; edits audited as procedure.update; override/units not reset.
missing_or_wrong: No Contract picker for the anaesthetist (filtered per US-04.3.2)
Window ends at SUBMITTED not AUTHORISED
No reset of price/rate/discount/units on change
Not flagged for office review
No 'No contract (RVG)' Contract; switching route to billableParty is the nearest equivalent
items.verify_note: Re-read both sheets and editRefusal; confirmed.
items.title: Anaesthetist can change the Contract

items.summary: The anaesthetist always gets an override with a mandatory reason; the per-Contract flag, read-only price, fixed-price lock, prepaid lock and fixed-discount display are all absent.
items.requirement_says: What the anaesthetist can change depends on a per-Contract flag set by AA: price, rate or discount when allowed (100% discount or $0 gives a no-charge invoice); read-only price with no discount field when not; a fixed price always read-only; a Contract-fixed discount shown and not editable; prepaid never editable. No reason is needed; the change is audited and flagged at office review.
items.prototype_does: OverrideCard writes a typed priceOverride (dollarAdjustment or fixedFee) for any Procedure under capture, with a mandatory reason, rejecting totals below zero. % adjustment is office only. No Contract-level gating, no read-only mode keyed to Contract, no fixed discount shown.
missing_or_wrong: No Contract flag and no 'Not allowed' state (price read-only, no discount field)
No read-only 'Fixed price' on Type 3 or hospital fixed Contracts (anaesthetist can override them)
Prepaid Procedures not locked against override
No fixed-discount display where the price change would be
Reason required instead of 'saves without a reason'
No flag at office review for an anaesthetist-entered price or discount
Discount and rate not editable as such; no no-charge invoice path (fee at or below 0 refused in validator)
items.verify_note: Re-read OverrideCard and validator against all five ACs: Own pricing (partially, but ungated), Not allowed, Fixed price, Fixed discount and No reason all fail. Shares one implementation with FT-03.5.
items.title: Apply an anaesthetist adjustment

items.summary: BTM values are stored independent of the fee, but BTM/times are mandatory on any RVG-coded Procedure, including fixed price; zero fee raises no invoice.
items.requirement_says: Full BTM kept even at 100% discount (zero fee); BTM not mandatory on a fixed-price Contract, still mandatory on a fixed-rate Contract.
items.prototype_does: baseUnitsCaptured/timeUnitsCaptured/modifierUnitsCaptured and times stored independent of override; fee can reach zero by adjustment; times required on every RVG-coded procedure whatever the Contract; zero total group skipped at invoicing.
missing_or_wrong: BTM/times mandatory on fixed-price Contract (must be optional); fixed-price vs fixed-rate distinction not modelled
No-charge (zero) invoice not produced
items.verify_note: Forced times on fixed price is wrong behaviour against the stated rule, so Contradicts. The retention half matches. Agreed status so re-checked.
items.title: BTM still recorded in full

items.summary: The completion gate exists (Mark complete refused with a flagged list) but its rules are the old ones: it demands a billing route and an RVG code or billing line, requires times whenever an RVG code is set, never requires a Contract, and has no modifier-explanation rule.
items.requirement_says: Before Mark complete every Procedure must have a Contract, its times recorded where the Contract prices from time (not on a fixed price), and a short explanation for any modifier claimed. RVG code is optional; the insurance approval number is not needed but is shown where the Booking holds one and may be changed on the day. Cannot-complete cases go to the office (US-03.6.3).
items.prototype_does: completeBooking refuses unless validateBookingForBilling passes. It fails when: billingRoute unset; no rvgBaseCode and no non-RVG line; with an RVG code, start/handover missing or handover not after start; range base code lacks a selected value; insurer, payer-category or prepayment detail problems; rateTime line without a permitting contract; override without reason or negative; funder-allocation conservation. A Booking with no governing contract passes (default pricing).
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: an RVG base code or a billing line is mandatory (validateBookingForBilling.ts:129-133); the requirement makes the RVG code optional
WRONG: times required whenever an RVG code is present (:135-154), not conditional on the Contract pricing from time; a fixed-price Contract should not need them
MISSING: a Contract is not required (governingContractId never validated; None/default pricing is allowed)
MISSING: no explanation required for a modifier claimed (ModifierChips has no reason field; searched modifierReason|modifierNote -> none)
WRONG/extra: billing route, insurer, payment category, prepayment detail and range-base selection are completion blockers; none is in the new minimum

PARTIAL: the hospital contract/approval reference (billingReference) is shown on the context line (BtmCaptureBlock.tsx:107-110) and editable in EditProcedureSheet, but there is no insurance approval number field for the insurer route, so 'show it where the Booking holds one' is only met for the hospital reference
Not graded: 'send to office to resolve' is US-03.6.3
items.verify_note: Re-read the validator and completeBooking: the contradictions are real. Corrected one point: the reviewer said the approval number is not shown or changeable by the anaesthetist, but the hospital billingReference is shown in the context line and editable in the Edit procedure sheet. It is not an insurance approval number, so the point is downgraded to partial rather than dropped.
items.title: Mark a Booking complete

items.summary: List submit blockers sheet names each incomplete Booking and exactly what is missing, on both apps.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist sees which Bookings on a List are incomplete and exactly what is missing from each.
items.prototype_does: Greyed 'Mark list completed . N to finish' (mobile) and 'N to finish before submitting' (web) open SubmitListSheet blockers mode: each non-cancelled incomplete Booking by time and patient with every validation failure verbatim, or 'Ready to complete'; in-Booking latch focuses first missing field.
items.verify_note: Agreed status so re-checked: re-read SubmitListSheet and completionBlockersFor; the story is only the display and it is met. Message wording (e.g. 'handover') belongs to US-03.3.3/03.6.1. Note 16 Oct pre/post-op time question unsettled.
items.title: Incomplete Bookings listed

items.summary: No way for the anaesthetist to alert the office about a Booking or List with a note; pool carries only listMoved and has no resolved state.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist can flag a Booking or List with a note; an active notice posts to the shared notification pool and stays until the office ticks it resolved.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. Notification kind is only listMoved, not actionable, no read/resolved state; no flag control on Booking or List.
missing_or_wrong: Ask-the-office control with note on Booking and List (mobile and web)
New notification kind carrying the note
Office tick-resolved in admin Notifications (pool deliberately has no actioned state today)
Rule on submit while flagged (undecided)
evidence: searched: askOffice|alertOffice|needsCheck|flagForOffice|ask the office in aa-prototype/src -> only availability copy
items.demo_trigger: Admin Notifications page is the office side (tick resolved); for the PWA add stand-in 'Office resolves alert' on the mobile Booking/List screen that ticks the notice resolved.
items.verify_note: Grepped the repo; no implementation. Pool rule is hard-coded to list moves.
items.title: Ask the office to check a Booking or List

items.summary: The add-event action creates a linked Booking on a new List in today's session and is offered only on an AUTHORISED (locked) Booking; it lacks the event's own date/time, time-or-fixed-fee choice, invoice tick, same-as billable party and the 'not on a List' rule.
items.requirement_says: From a current or past Procedure the anaesthetist (or admin) adds an event with its own date and time, recording a time or a fixed fee, no other modifiers; it is its own element attached to the Procedure; invoice tick box; billable party set with a 'same as' tick; it appears on no List or schedule even when dated another day.
items.prototype_does: 'Add post-op event' button (BookingDetailBody.tsx:654-668) on a Booking whose List is AUTHORISED calls addPostOpAddendum, creating an empty Procedure on a new Booking on a new List in today's first free session; the user then captures it like any Booking (full BTM including modifiers). Billing context is inherited from the first procedure with no choice of party. Admin and anaesthetist get the same button (editRefusal rules).
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: event is a Booking on a List and schedule (today's session), contradicting 'Not on a List'
WRONG: the addendum has full capture, so modifiers, ASA and RVG base units are available; events take a time or fixed fee only
MISSING: event's own date and time; it is dated by today's session
MISSING: invoice tick box (an unbilled event cannot be recorded)
MISSING: billable party with a same-as tick; the party is only inherited

MISSING: offered only on AUTHORISED Bookings; not on a current Procedure and not on a past Procedure the anaesthetist can open (US-03.1.6); billed Lists leave the anaesthetist's views at authorise (store/selectors.ts, billedAtISO)
MISSING: refused when no free session today (noOpenSession)
MISSING: no event list on the Procedure; the admin 'someone rings' flow is only the same button
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/billingRun.ts:1-30 (billing runs on listAuthorised; billedAtISO hides the List)
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Stage post-op scenario' stages the locked original; keep it (or add 'Open past Procedure') and add the event from the Procedure on mobile, web and admin.
items.verify_note: Status Agreed, so re-checked all acceptance criteria against addPostOpAddendum and the button. Every point the reviewer raised holds: no tick, no own date, no same-as party, no modifier restriction, and the event shows on a List. Contradicts is correct.
items.title: Add a pre-op or post-op event to a Procedure

items.summary: A post-op charge ends up on its own invoice traceable to the original, and fixed-amount billing lines (description plus amount) exist on a Procedure, but there is no event-level billing: no next-run pick-up, no bundling by billable party, no credit event, no invoice tick, and no event review step.
items.requirement_says: A billing event is a free-form charge (description plus amount) or a credit on a Procedure; if marked for invoicing it is billed in the next billing run through the standard review step, never held for the Procedure's invoice; bundled onto the invoice for the same billable party in that run where possible, otherwise its own invoice traceable to the Procedure; not invoiced if not reviewed or if the tick is cleared; a credit reduces what is owed and is traceable.
items.prototype_does: The billing run is per-List and fires synchronously when a List is authorised (runBillingForList, grouped by counterparty per Booking). A post-op addendum Booking on its own List is billed by its own run as a separate invoice and links back via addendumOfBookingId. Separately, addBillingLine adds fixed or rate x time lines with a free-text description to a Procedure before authorisation. Invoice.kind is only standard|prePayment; a negative price override is blocked as a credit note 'this system never raises'.
missing_or_wrong: MISSING: event-level 'next billing run'; there is only the per-List run on authorise
MISSING: bundling an event onto another invoice for the same billable party in the run; the addendum always gets its own invoice
MISSING: credit event or credit note path; the validator refuses negative totals (validateBookingForBilling.ts:203-215)
MISSING: invoice tick box (cleared = not invoiced)
MISSING: 'not through review = not invoiced' for events; review is the List authorise, tied to a session
MISSING: event billable party differing from the Procedure's
MISSING: description plus amount as an event; billing lines attach only before authorisation on a Procedure, and rate x time must pass the Method 3 gate
Related: additional invoice US-08.6.3 and credit note US-08.6.5 belong to EP-08
items.demo_trigger: Proposed: on the Admin billing monitor, a 'Run next billing run' button that picks up every reviewed, invoice-ticked event, bundles those sharing a billable party with other lines in the run, and raises the rest as their own invoices (visible in the invoice list, traceable to the Procedure); plus a 'Review event' step in the admin review queue.
items.verify_note: Considered Contradicts because the negative-fee refusal rejects a credit and billing is per-List rather than per-run. Kept Partial: the negative block is on price override, not on a credit event, and the addendum's own-invoice and traceability outcomes are consistent with the story. The wrong implementation sits in FT-03.7/US-03.7.1 (event as a Booking), which are already graded Contradicts. Re-opened billingRun.ts, billingLineActions.ts and Invoice.kind; the reviewer's points all hold.

A Procedure with a post-op event and an additional invoice shows both; a credit note against its invoice shows as an event.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. The Booking detail shows a 'Post-op addendum' banner on the addendum only; the original Booking shows no list of its addenda. The History sheet is an audit timeline, not an events list. No additional invoices or credit notes exist to show.

Original Booking does not list its addendum
No additional invoice or credit surfaced as events (depends on EP-08)
No refund-as-event record

items.summary: The prototype is built on the July RFP model (Type 1/2/3 contracts, a required billingRoute plus optional governing Contract, protected hospital and insurer default Type 1s, Insurer master); the catalogue replaces it with one Contract per Procedure that decides pricing and who is billed.

items.prototype_does: Contract has type 1|2|3, holderType, scope, permitsIndividualArrangement, isDefault. Procedure carries billingRoute (hospital, billableParty, insurer) and an optional governingContractId; resolveContractForProcedure resolves the route first and falls back to a per-hospital or per-insurer default Type 1. Contracts are edited in place and deleted.

items.summary: Rate and percentage discount exist only as contract-wide Type 2 terms; Type 3 uses ordinal-keyed price rows and Method 3 rate x time is gated by permitsIndividualArrangement, which the catalogue no longer has; no editable flag, unit overrides or holder references on the Contract.

The Contract rate is a unit rate, not hourly (OQ-89).
items.prototype_does: feeFor: Type 1 = units x unit value; Type 2 = agreed unit rate or % off unit value for the whole Contract; Type 3 = ContractPrice match (most specific, incl. second-procedure ordinal) with BTM fallback; captured rateTime lines allowed under permitsIndividualArrangement. Typed price override is office-only with a reason. billingReference is per Procedure.

OQ-89 and US-05.2.6 settle that a Contract rate is a unit rate for the whole Procedure and not rate x time, so the implemented hourly/Method 3 gating under a Contract and the ordinal rows are implemented behaviour that is wrong. Under the rules that makes it Contradicts. The Type 3 BTM fallback itself is consistent with 'a Contract with no matching line prices at BTM x unit value', so not a defect.

Story is Open under OQ-131.

The anaesthetist OverrideCard (Adjustment or Charge with reason) is available regardless of the Contract.

Another anaesthetist's list is not hidden from a Booking (unfiltered select)

No prepaid flag on a Contract; picking it does not start the prepayment
Holder is not 'not billed, payer on Booking billed'; billing follows billingRoute

If the prepayment exceeds the fee it raises a negativeTotal billing exception ('an overpaid pre-payment needs a manual credit'). items.summary: The engine builds, sends and mirrors invoices, but it nets prepaid amounts as a visible negative line instead of leaving prepaid Procedures off (wrong), and there is no internal ledger as system of record (missing).

The internal ledger, not Xero, is the system of record. Delivery constraint: a one-month parallel run with variance reconciliation.
items.prototype_does: wireBillingRun builds invoices per Booking on AUTHORISED, ranks across all Procedures for multi-procedure pricing, emails an invoice document and hands off to a Xero ACCREC plus draft ACCPAY pair. A prepaid Procedure still gets its fee lines plus a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' negative line. The receivable/payable pair exists only in the Xero simulation slice; no ledger exists.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: prepaid Procedures are netted by a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line, not left off (see US-08.2.2)
No internal ledger as system of record: the pair is state.xero.accRecs/accPays and nothing survives independently of Xero
No AA Holding account creditor and no journal transfer on authorisation for prepaid Bookings
Ledger balance views (whole ledger, per anaesthetist, per patient) from the domain model are absent
Parallel-run reconciliation (legacy vs new variance report) is not represented

A prepayment invoice's payable is to the AA Holding account, with a second pair moving it to the anaesthetist at settlement. The monthly AA fee invoice has no payable. The ledger tracks per patient and per anaesthetist and keeps history independent of Xero contact changes.

Prepayment invoices go through the same handoff (prepaymentActions calls handoffCasesForBooking), so the payable is to the List's anaesthetist and is authorised as payments arrive. AA fee invoices are ACCRECs of kind aaFee with no ACCPAY (matches). Patient contacts are pseudonymised and archive in Xero.

WRONG: prepayment payable is to the anaesthetist (xeroHandoff resolves the List's anaesthetist), not the AA Holding account

items.summary: The only late-charge path is the old post-op addendum (a separate Booking on a new List, priced by Contract/RVG), which contradicts the now-written model of events on the Procedure and free-form additional invoices; credit/rebill and next-run bundling are also absent.
items.requirement_says: Late charges and corrections are handled without unlocking the immutable Booking: late charges are additional invoices or post-op events (both events on the Procedure, standard review, billed in the next run, bundled per billable party where possible); a wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; a post-invoice split uses the credit note option then new additional invoices.
items.prototype_does: An 'Add post-op event' button on an AUTHORISED Booking calls addPostOpAddendum, which creates a separate postOpAddendum Booking on a new List in today's free session of the original anaesthetist; the original stays locked. The addendum then goes through its own List submit, authorise and billing-run cycle, priced from Contract/RVG. No additional invoice, credit note, credit-and-rebill, event element or per-billable-party bundling. Invoice.kind is only 'standard'|'prePayment'. Code comments mark the addendum as interim.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: late charge is modelled as a separate Booking on a new List needing a free session, not an event on the Procedure; it is priced by Contract/RVG, not free-form.
WRONG: the addendum goes through the List submit/authorise cycle, not the standard event review step, and is not billed in the next run as an event.
Additional invoice (free-form, attached to the original Procedure) does not exist (see US-08.6.3).
Credit in full then rebill does not exist (no credit note, no payable reversal, no negative invoice netted in a payment run; see US-08.6.2).
Credit note option for splits does not exist (see US-08.6.5).
No rule that every event marked for invoicing is billed in the next run on the same invoice as other lines for the same billable party (OQ-121).

items.summary: The final-invoice run still uses the older deposit/net model: it prices every prepaid Procedure and appends a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' deduction line (and bills a split-prepay balance), where the requirement says prepaid Procedures are simply left off with no deduction line.
items.requirement_says: When invoices are generated for an AUTHORISED List, every prepaid Procedure is left off them (no deduction, no prepayment line). A mixed Booking's final invoice carries only the not-prepaid Procedures; an all-prepaid Booking has no final invoice; a prepaid primary does not change the additional Procedure's multi-procedure price (ranking is across all Procedures). The prepaid price is the issued prepayment invoice amount, BTM units are reference only, and no automatic difference invoice or credit is raised.
items.prototype_does: billingRun threads prePaidByProcedure (summed from the Booking's prePayment invoice lines) into buildInvoicesForBooking. That function rates every Procedure (prepaid ones included) via feeFor, tags the fee lines, then for a prepaid Procedure pushes a negative line 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced'. A group that nets to $0 is dropped, so an all-prepaid Booking raises no invoice only by arithmetic. If the rated fee exceeds the prepaid amount the surplus is billed to the patient; if lower, the Booking fails with a negativeTotal exception ('an overpaid pre-payment needs a manual credit'). Split (flat deposit) prepayments bill the remaining balance. Guards prepaidFunderOverride and prepaidCounterpartyChanged exist only for the netting model. Ranking is index+1 over all Procedures, so a prepaid primary would still rank the additional correctly, but only because the prepaid primary stays in the build. No UI or demo control shows a prepaid Procedure left off.
missing_or_wrong: Prepaid Procedures are priced and netted via a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line instead of being omitted from the final invoice (patient sees a prepayment line; requirement says no prepayment is deducted from any invoice)

Prepaid price should be the issued prepayment invoice amount with BTM units reference only; the prototype re-rates the Procedure and bills the surplus or raises a negativeTotal exception on a shortfall, which breaks 'never invoices or credits a difference by itself'
Split/deposit prepayment type (flat deposit then balance) is the old model; prepayments are all-or-nothing, so partial netting should go
All-prepaid Booking should explicitly yield no final invoice, not depend on a $0 net
Mixed Booking: the final invoice should carry only the not-prepaid Procedure; currently the prepaid Procedure's fee lines plus the deduction appear
Prepaid primary: the additional must stay ranked as additional while the primary is omitted after ranking; needs explicit omit-after-ranking logic and a test
Anaesthetist payment for a prepaid Procedure should come from the AA Holding account transfer (US-06.5.1), not a patient invoice; no such path in the invoice engine
prepaidFunderOverride and prepaidCounterpartyChanged exceptions, and the 'Less pre-payment' wording, are obsolete
Seed (SEED_PREPAID_BOOKING_ID), tests and demo guide Beat 1 / S3 beats assume deposit-then-balance netting
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/invoiceBuild.ts:52-59 (prePaidByProcedure doc: appends one visible deduction line per prepaid procedure)
aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/invoiceBuild.ts:385-395 ('Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced', negative amount)

items.summary: Both NHI formats are validated by one pure module with the right shapes and check characters, wired into booking creation, PDF ingest and an admin validator. Only the 'modulus 24' label for the current format differs, a deliberate documented ruling.
items.requirement_says: Validate current (AAANNNC, text says modulus 24) and new (AAANNAX, modulus 23) NHI formats; never assume numeric or sequential; working before 1 July 2027.
items.prototype_does: domain/nhi.ts validateNhi detects format by character class, checks current format by weighted mod 11 (the real Health NZ algorithm; RFP's own example ZAA0067 only validates under mod 11) and new format by mod 23, rejects I and O, gives plain reasons; generateNhi makes non-sequential seeded NHIs of both formats. Integrations Validators tab shows an NHI validator and says on screen that the RFP's 'Modulus 24' label does not fit its own examples.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Admin, Integrations, Validators tab accepts ZAA0067 / ACA31FM and rejects a bad check digit.
items.verify_note: Read nhi.ts algorithms. Catalogue literally says modulus 24 for the current format but the prototype uses mod 11 by prior ruling and flags it on screen; behaviour a presenter shows (both formats validated, bad check rejected) satisfies the story, so kept Matches with medium confidence. If the catalogue wording is ever treated as binding this would become Contradicts, but switching to mod 24 would reject real NHIs.
items.title: Dual-format NHI validation

items.summary: The prototype implements the dropped reading: a Booking goes ahead for a provisional 'NHI pending' patient, instead of the NHI-less incoming booking waiting on the unmatched queue with a stub on its List and no Booking or patient record.
