summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is the July RFP model with Phases 15 to 32 layered on. Calendar, Slots, Lists, Draft Lists, pairings, tiers, warnings engine, the AA fee run and the Xero simulation are close to the catalogue. Money and intake are not. Of roughly 235 graded items, about 40 Match, about 25 are Partial, about 15 are Missing, and the rest are Contradicts or Grouping. Contradicts dominates EP-02 to EP-08, EP-11 and EP-12: the prototype implements a different, superseded design there, not a smaller version of the new one. EP-01, EP-10 and most of EP-13 are near done. The core is one coordinated rework: Contract (holder, dated versions, lines, flags) replaces billing route plus Type 1/2/3. Pricing, completion, prepayment, invoicing, payer, review and events all hang off it. Statuses were not used to scope work; they appear below only where an open question (OQ) makes a gap unsafe.

### Themes

**1. Contract-centred billing (XL).** Billing route, optional governing Contract, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s go. In: holders with an is-billed flag, dated Contract versions with AA code, standalone lines, one AA-held No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review and submit, authorisation snapshot, filtered picker, anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to 04.3, US-04.1.1 to 04.1.6, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-08.1.1, US-07.3.1. DM-07, DM-09, DM-10, DM-48, DM-49, DM-57, DM-08, DM-16. RV-06, RV-11, RV-18, RV-32. Split into model and maths, versioning and staging screens, picker and booking setup.

**2. Pricing, units and modifiers (XL).** Price, rate and discount become values on the Procedure; no mandatory reason; Contract flag gates the anaesthetist; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; discount is its own invoice line; modifier units split above four; RVG becomes a hidden-key master (NZSA 2021, duplicate codes); modifiers become records with explanations, age pre-applied, ASA ordinary; out-of-range warns instead of blocking; completion rules reworked ("finish", not "handover"). Items: FT-05.1 to 05.4, US-05.x, FT-03.3, FT-03.5, US-03.3.x, US-03.5.x, US-03.6.1. DM-13, DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-46. RV-03, RV-04, RV-07 to RV-10, RV-21, RV-22, RV-38. Many S quick wins (NHI, wording, reason removal, make-primary).

**3. Hospital intake matching screen (XL).** Nothing exists: HL7/FHIR and PDF rows apply straight to Bookings. Needed: staged rows, match/create/Draft List/assign/reject, per-row change type, field differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits allowed until AUTHORISED, third feed (CPH) out of scope. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-02.5.7, US-02.3.1, EP-14 (boundary). DM-34, DM-51. RV-12 to RV-16.

**4. NHI mandatory and source text (M, tied to 3).** Remove provisional patients and "NHI pending"; waiting-for-NHI queue with urgency; text exactly as received per source plus a separate invoice description. Items: US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6. DM-30, DM-51. RV-20.

**5. Prepayment and holding account (XL).** Trigger is a prepaid Contract, amount is the line price, admin approval plus letter, payable to a holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Today the anaesthetist is paid before the procedure. Items: EP-06, FT-06.2 to 06.5, US-06.x, FT-08.1, FT-08.3, US-08.2.2, US-08.3.1, FT-09.1, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.3. DM-20, DM-21, DM-22. RV-05, RV-24.

**6. Events, additional invoices, credit notes (XL).** Post-op addendum Booking is replaced by events on the Procedure, additional free-form invoices, credit-in-full-then-rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly cycle. Items: FT-03.7, US-03.7.x, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.5, US-10.2.6. DM-17, DM-18, DM-24, DM-25. RV-23.

**7. Edit window and anaesthetist views (M).** Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED; a List leaves the main view at AUTHORISED (not billed); balances show invoices immediately; search by name/NHI/date; scroll back. Items: EP-07, FT-07.2, FT-07.4, US-07.2.1, US-07.2.3, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2, US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7. DM-55. RV-19.

**8. OQ-81 reversal (M to L).** Unavailability is never a conflict; closed sessions not assignable by the office; sickness takes return-or-assign to a Draft List. Items: US-01.5.2, US-01.5.4, US-01.6.3, US-01.5.5, US-01.4.1. DM-56. RV-25.

**9. Single-Booking move and notification pool (M).** Anaesthetist moves one Booking by creating a List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an "ask the office" source. Items: US-01.4.7, US-01.4.6, US-01.4.2, FT-13.8, US-13.8.1 to 13.8.3, US-03.6.3. DM-42, DM-41. RV-26, RV-27.

**10. Payer, insurer, balances, warnings (L).** Payer name and email on the Booking; insurer and approval number on the Booking; patient balance alerts at 90 days; remaining warning rules; admin whole-ledger views. Items: EP-11, FT-11.2 to 11.4, US-11.2.2/3, US-11.3.2, US-11.4.x, US-13.7.1, US-07.2.2. DM-11, DM-12, DM-23, DM-31, DM-28. RV-30, RV-31, RV-36.

**11. Profile, reports, admin polish (M).** Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST report of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing orders candidates, audit excludes payments, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. Items: FT-12.1, FT-12.2, US-12.1.1, US-12.2.2, US-13.4.1, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.2, US-13.5.3, US-13.6.4, US-15.0.1, US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6. DM-29, DM-32, DM-35, DM-38, DM-45. RV-02, RV-33, RV-35.

### Structural first

Screen work built before these lands is rebuilt twice. Suggested order:

1. DM-13 (RVG group, hidden key), DM-48 (holders), then DM-07, DM-09, DM-49 (Contract versions, lines, No contract) in one step with DM-46 (remove BillingLine). Then DM-10 (Procedure picks Contract and line), which unblocks DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-08 and DM-11.
2. DM-22 (internal ledger with its own payable) before DM-21 (holding account) and DM-20 (prepaid trigger); DM-17 (events) before DM-18, DM-24, then DM-25.
3. DM-30 (NHI required) and DM-51 (source text) before DM-34 (matching rows).
4. DM-57 (staged Contract changes) after DM-07 and DM-09.
5. Independent, can run any time: DM-55, DM-56, DM-42, DM-41, DM-32, DM-12. DM-29 follows DM-22. DM-45 is a policy note, fold into DM-07 or DM-24.

Every seed or type change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump, canvas-golden and seed tests refreshed. About 26 non-test files read governingContractId or billingRoute, so DM-10 is the widest change.

### Remove or rework (reverse check)

- Remove: attachments on Bookings and Lists (RV-01, M); GST period (RV-02, S); rate x time billing and Method 3 flag (RV-03, M; keep fixed ancillary lines until events exist); ACC "should not bill patient" review flag (RV-37, S).
- Rework (large): prepayment category and split (RV-05), default Type 1 fallback (RV-06), billing-time re-resolution (RV-11), route plus Type model (RV-18), prepaid pair paying anaesthetist (RV-24), addendum Booking (RV-23), HL7 auto-apply and third feed (RV-16).
- Rework (small to medium): price reason and flag (RV-04), ordinal pricing (RV-07), modifier split (RV-08), P1 absorption (RV-09), range hard bound (RV-10), completion rules (RV-21), ASA seeding (RV-22), unavailability conflict (RV-25), notice caption and OQ-84 hint (RV-26), office write-through with no Save (RV-28), per-Procedure payer (RV-30), line-level funder split (RV-31), in-place Contract edits (RV-32), GST receipts (RV-33), ageing buckets (RV-35), prior-balance pill (RV-36), modifier master values (RV-38).
- Hide from demo: Surgeon PDF tab (RV-12, no Future badge), automated change behaviours (RV-13), Productivity and Leave panels (RV-34).
- Keep as scaffold: reliability tooling residue (RV-15), photo capture (RV-17).
- Owner questions, not defects: office single-Booking move targets (RV-27); anaesthetist seeing no price (RV-29, Donald's own 28 Sept decision, conflicts with US-03.1.2 and FT-03.5).

### Demo impact

- S1: Beat 1 (Fire hospital message creates the Booking, "arrives in a later build") rewrites around the matching screen. Beat 3 capture changes: optional numeric RVG codes, no ASA seeding, modifier explanations, "finish" wording, Contract line on screen.
- S2: Beats 1b, 3 and 3a (sickness conflict, assign to closed session) change with OQ-81. Phone-advice beat needs the optional "as given" text and mandatory NHI. Beat 3c (own move) gains single-Booking move. Beat 4 and "submit sheet" copy change with the until-AUTHORISED edit rule; review screen content changes. Notification beat loses busy-morning paging.
- S3: billing Beats 1 to 2 (payer/route wording, pair), split-billing and two-funder beats, payables beat if the prepay payable moves to the holding account, GST and balances messaging (invoices now immediate).
- S4: Beat 1 (prepayment warning, Annette Riley), Beat 2 (post-op addendum, explicitly interim), billing failure and retry (relies on default fallback and un-end-dating), dead-letter and feed-mapping beats (CPH feed).
- Compliance tour: Contract effective-dating beat (edit in place becomes a new dated version), ASA edit seeding units, Master data Contracts click paths. Cheat sheet lines on "default Type 1", billing route, "office-only edits" after submit, and "Prior balance" also need edits.
- Unchanged: FT-02.4 ad hoc add (bar NHI), S2 own-move line "nothing recalculated", most fee-run beats.

### Demo-trigger buttons

The product owner's pattern: screen-contextual buttons in the top control area. Roughly 55 items name a trigger; about half already exist and need repointing (Simulate sickness, Fire hospital message, Stage post-op scenario, Authorise List, Raise sample warnings, month-end fee run). About 25 need genuinely new buttons. Clusters:

- Intake: "Receive tomorrow's theatre list" (St George's, Southern Cross), "Receive a changed list", "Receive list with a missing NHI" on the matching screen (FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5).
- Prepay and ledger: "Prepay holding account" card, "Approve and send" with letter template, "Mark procedure done", "Email patient: anaesthetist changed", cancel-refund (FT-06.4, FT-06.5, US-06.3.1, US-06.3.6, US-06.5.x, FT-08.3).
- Credits and events: "Run next billing run", "Credit and rebill", "Stage double payment", seeded events list (FT-08.6, US-08.6.2, US-03.7.3).
- Contracts: "Stage a price review" creating a future-dated version, then advance the clock (US-04.2.10).
- Stand-ins for colleagues or office: "Ask Dr X to make this session available" (US-01.6.3), "Office resolves alert" (US-03.6.3), "Colleague moves one of my Bookings" (US-01.4.7), "ACCPAY paid in Xero" (US-09.2.4).
- Warnings and balances: new samples for child payer, insurer with no Contract, balance (mild, strong, credit), out-of-range base units (US-13.7.1, US-11.3.2, US-03.3.1).
- Platform: "Load full-scale dataset", "Run NHI leak scan", "Run cutover data load", "Skip sign-in", approve-week's-BCTIs (US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.3, US-10.2.6).
- No trigger needed: EP-05 pricing (seed scenarios instead: 3-procedure 7-unit Booking, discount Contract, flag-off Contract, $0 Booking).

### Uncertainty

Unsafe to build fully until answered:

- OQ-95 (modifier application, age bands): US-03.3.4, US-03.3.8, US-05.1.4, US-05.1.5, RV-22, RV-38. Build age and ASA changes as labelled simplifications.
- OQ-101 (RVG ranges, system code), OQ-102 (tier names), OQ-113 (colleague ordering): US-05.1.1, US-03.3.1, US-01.3.6, US-01.4.5.
- OQ-105, OQ-106, OQ-93, OQ-98, OQ-114, OQ-99 (surgeon arrangements, insurance filtering, flag purpose): US-04.1.5, US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2, US-04.3.3, FT-11.4, US-11.4.1. These gate the picker and who-is-billed, so DM-48 and DM-10 have a soft edge here.
- OQ-96, OQ-97, OQ-104, OQ-116 (prepaid price edits, part credit, price held on issued invoice, mixed Bookings), OQ-115 (refund route): EP-06 detail, FT-06.4, US-06.5.2, US-08.6.2. Build assumptions in the catalogue.
- OQ-100 (data load, upload) and OQ-103 (invoice description for RVG Contract): US-04.1.6, US-13.4.3, US-08.4.6.
- OQ-109 and OQ-13 (hospital feeds, formats): the matching screen's row shape, US-02.1.1, US-02.1.5. Build against canned rows.
- OQ-111, OQ-47, OQ-112, OQ-29, OQ-60, OQ-12: payables detection (US-09.2.4, hold), weekly cycle (US-10.2.6, US-10.2.7), fee run label, BCTI wording (US-09.1.4 placeholder only), ACC pre-op codes (US-05.5.2).
- OQ-85 and OQ-83: single-Booking move edges, sign-in (keep skippable).
- Catalogue inconsistencies to raise with the owner, not build around: US-01.5.4 AC "reassign clears a hospital-closure conflict"; US-03.3.4 locked versus US-05.1.4 not locked; US-15.0.1 "no Contract complexity" versus US-03.1.2; US-07.4.1 screenshot caption; US-04.2.10 relink versus authorisation lock.
- Items whose status is Open or Verify (for example US-03.1.9, US-03.3.1, US-03.4.1, US-03.6.1, US-01.4.6) were graded against their text; confirm before treating them as settled.

dataModelDeltas.title: The RVG group becomes the one master list (hidden key, type-ahead rows, modifier units, AA groups); there is no procedure list
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base units sit on the RVG group (NZSA RVG plus AA's own groups): code, description, anatomy heading, base units always set and above 0, modifier units default 0. Codes are not unique, so a row has a hidden key and the same code can appear on several rows. RVG groups are the one master list: no procedure list, body-section picker or general procedure. Picked by type-ahead showing code, description and base units. RVG code on a Procedure is optional; the Booking's procedure is the text received. Seeded once, then hand-maintained with audit. OQ-101: group holds the printed base-unit range and the anaesthetist chooses the exact units.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Only RvgCode keyed by its code string (types.ts:919): description, anatomicalSite string, baseUnits single or range, absorbsModifierCodes; 34 demo rows, view-only Master Data table with no write action. Procedure.rvgBaseCode is a scalar string and the validator requires one unless a billing line exists. No hidden key, duplicate codes, modifier units, AA groups or type-ahead showing base units.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Foundation for the pricing track. RvgCode gets a hidden id, anatomy heading and modifier units; Procedure.rvgBaseCode becomes an optional group reference (22 non-test files); absorbsModifierCodes moves to DM-44. Seed needs the real group list; the code picker gains type-ahead rows. Must precede DM-09, DM-43, DM-44.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Code re-read: RvgCode keyed by code string, 34 seed rows, validator fails an unset rvgBaseCode unless a non-RVG line exists (validateBookingForBilling.ts:130). US-05.1.6 in the refs is Retired and is a boundary reference only (the procedure master goes).

dataModelDeltas.title: The contract holder becomes a master record (insurer, hospital, surgeon, anaesthetist; AA holds No contract) with an is-billed flag, a billable party, an invoice delivery output and a practitioner link; the Insurer master goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Contract belongs to a holder: insurer, hospital, surgeon or anaesthetist (own price list); AA holds No contract (RVG). Insurers are ordinary holders: the insurer master and accepts-direct-claims flag are retired. A surgeon's arrangement is held against individual surgeons, and one Contract links to many surgeons. Each holder records whether AA invoices it (billable party required) or only sets the price (Booking payer billed), how invoices are delivered (flag on holder or billable party; other outputs OQ-114), and optionally practitioner IDs (one anaesthetist or one or more surgeons) so Contracts are offered only on those people's Bookings. Office creates holders and Contracts from the price list.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holder entity. Contract carries holderType hospital|insurer|surgeon|organisation|billableParty plus holderId into four disjoint tables; ContractScope individualAnaesthetist is the only practitioner link, one anaesthetist; a surgeon holder is one surgeonId. Insurer master with acceptsDirectClaims gates the Insurer route (44 non-test files mention insurers, 10 read the flag). No is-billed flag, no delivery output.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New holder master with CRUD; Contract.holderType/holderId (10 non-test files) become a holder reference and the practitioner link becomes a list. Insurer master and acceptsDirectClaims removed (seed, Master Data view, Insurer route in invoiceBuild and validator, manual-booking and billing-setup sheets). Organisation and billableParty holder kinds have no counterpart. Delivery flag added here. Needed before DM-07, DM-49, DM-10, DM-11, DM-12.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Counts re-run (44 insurer files, 10 acceptsDirectClaims, 10 holderType). US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2, FT-11.2 and US-13.4.1 are Agreed or lower, in scope, none Retired.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract becomes a series of dated versions with an AA code and behaviour flags; Type 1/2/3, scope, the default per holder and the Method 3 gate go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract has no kinds. Each is a series of dated versions (start, optional end, review date, forward link) with all lines sharing the dates; every change creates a new version from a chosen non-past date, nothing deleted, one future version at a time; the version in force on the procedure date prices. On submit un-invoiced Procedures relink to the new version's line by line key; prepaid keeps its invoiced price. Unique AA code. Flags set by AA: editable, prepaid, default (No contract RVG), plus invoice layout and GST treatment; billed is on the holder. Prepaid is never editable and its line price must be above zero; a fixed price never allows the anaesthetist override. NEW 4 Nov: how the office keeps a Contract current (whole-Contract dated versions, a date per line, or in-place edit with audit) is open OQ-131 for Vanessa; US-04.2.10 and US-04.2.14 went Agreed to Open.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Contract: type 1|2|3, holderType/holderId, scope, permitsIndividualArrangement, isDefault, effectiveFromISO/effectiveToISO, type2Detail. No version link, review date, AA code, editable or prepaid flag; contractActions edits in place with audit. Effectiveness judged on List date at billing; selection ranks individual over organisational over default. 12 seed Contracts.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Schema rewrite of the master pricing, billing and review read (26 non-test files touch governingContractId/billingRoute, 10 holderType). Needs DM-48 and DM-09 together. Rank-based selectContract replaced by DM-10's picker. Editable flag drives DM-14, prepaid flag DM-20. Until OQ-131 is answered build header, holder link, flags and a version row so a Contract resolves on its date; hold copy-lines, overlap guard and relink on submit (and DM-57) behind the answer; DM-08's snapshot keeps issued invoices independent of the editing model. Seed re-authored.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Seed Contracts counted at 12 (6 defaultType1 plus 6 explicit); rank() and isEffectiveOn read as described. OQ-131 is Open (status 1), so holding the version-copy steps is right.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract line (standalone, carrying only what it sets, with a system line key) replaces ContractPrice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract has lines or none. A line stands alone (no nesting, no procedure link; several may share a default RVG code). It carries only what it sets: system line key (never reused, kept on copy), optional holder reference code unique in the Contract, description that becomes the Procedure's invoice description when chosen (editable by admins), optional default RVG code, and any of fixed price (ex GST), rate, discount, base or modifier units. Blank is not set, 0 is a value. Removed: procedure link, RVG mapping, time band, add-on flag, quantity rule, price tier, line dates. On a prepaid Contract every line needs a price above zero.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ContractPrice: contractId, optional rvgBaseCode, surgeonId, procedureOrdinal, price. Only Type 3 Contracts use rows, most-specific-wins with BTM fallback. Rate and discount live on Contract.type2Detail. No line key, reference code, description, default RVG code or units override.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replaces masters.contractPrices and matchContractPrice (14 non-test files). Surgeon and ordinal prices re-expressed as surgeon-held Contracts and plain lines. Picker (DM-10), unit resolver (DM-43) and pricing (DM-50) read lines; Procedure points to a line. Seed and Master Data screens rewritten; save-time guard for prepaid lines. After DM-13 and DM-07. Line description is the top layer of DM-51's defaults.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: ContractPrice shape and 14-file count confirmed. Several cited items (US-04.2.4, US-05.2.5, US-05.2.6, US-04.2.11) are Agreed or Retired-adjacent boundaries, none relied on for a retired behaviour.

dataModelDeltas.title: One stored No contract (RVG), held by AA and never billed, replaces the protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct-billing insurer
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one No contract (RVG): held by AA (a holder never billed), no practice-wide prices, never expires, found by a flag, offered first for every procedure, billing the payer on the Booking. No hospital, insurer or per-procedure default Contracts; nothing derived from the List's location. A holder's plain RVG Contract with no lines is an ordinary Contract (OQ-98). Default-Contract feature Retired. NEW 4 Nov: in the working-direction step rail it is the answer for an unprepaid patient invoice; whether it also shows first in a Contract list is left to picker design (US-04.3.3).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A protected default Type 1 per hospital and per direct-claims insurer, created with the hospital or when the insurer flag flips, protected from delete and end-dating, used as fallback when a negotiated Contract is absent or expired. The Billable Party route resolves with no Contract at all.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Removal of an invariant the first pass counted as aligned. Delete per-holder creation, protection and fallback rules and tests; add one flagged Contract held by AA and the offered-first rule (now soft); payer-on-Booking billing replaces the Billable Party route (DM-11). Comes with DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: createHospital builds a default Type 1 (mastersActions.ts:80 to :93) and isProtectedDefault guards delete and end-date (contractActions.ts:24 to :27). FT-04.4, US-04.4.1 and US-04.4.2 are Retired and cited only as the boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure selects one Contract and, where it has lines, one line at booking setup; the billing route and billing-time Contract resolution disappear
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Procedure references exactly one Contract (and one line where it has lines) before the Booking can complete. The office sets it at booking setup (main job: identify who pays); a Booking without a Contract stays on the admin's list; RVG code or line may be left for the anaesthetist. The anaesthetist may change Contract, line and RVG code until AUTHORISED with no reason; changes audited and flagged at review; changing the Contract resets price, rate, discount and units. The picker lists Contracts not lines, No contract (RVG) first then hospital's then surgeons' and anaesthetists', valid on the procedure date with a fitting holder, with RVG reverse lookup and code search. The engine resolves no route or payer. NEW 4 Nov working direction (a guess): a step rail asking who the invoice goes to (patient, List's hospital, special contract), then prepaid or which Contract, then the price; the office's job ends at the Contract and an RVG-priced Contract goes to the anaesthetist for the RVG code (contract-picker-mock).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure carries billingRoute hospital|billableParty|insurer, governingContractId, insurerId, billablePartyId, patientPaymentCategory, prepaymentDetail. Route set explicitly (validator fails unset). Office stores the governing Contract and the billing run uses it while in effect, else falls back to the route holder's scoped or default Contract: stored but not versioned or locked. Only the office edits billing setup; the anaesthetist sees a read-only line. No Contract-change flag at review.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Central relationship change: Procedure.contractId (mandatory) and contractLineId replace route, governing Contract, insurer (to Booking, DM-12) and payment category (26 non-test files). Anaesthetist gains Contract and RVG picker and a change window to AUTHORISED; office review gains a Contract-change flag. Needs DM-13 to DM-49; unblocks DM-43, DM-50, DM-08, DM-11, DM-20. The step rail moves no structure (steps map to DM-48/DM-11, DM-07, line); its one model consequence is a Booking on an RVG-priced Contract with no RVG code shown to the anaesthetist as a derived to-do, not a stored state.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Route fields and validator branch (fail when billingRoute unset, validateBookingForBilling.ts:125) confirmed; 26-file count matches.

dataModelDeltas.title: Starting units come from the Contract line, then the RVG group, and become the Procedure's own values; any value is accepted and an out-of-range one only warns
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Choosing Contract/line and RVG code fills starting values: base units from the RVG code or the line's own, modifier units from 0 plus system-applied modifiers, price/rate/discount from the line. They then become the Procedure's own values, changeable to any figure including outside the published range, which raises an after-procedure warning and never blocks. Changing the Contract resets them. RVG code optional. A printed range is shown and the anaesthetist chooses exact base units (OQ-101).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: resolveBtm takes base units from the single RvgCode row (single, or range via baseUnitsSelected) with a captured override flagged overridden. No Contract-line layer, no reset on Contract change; price, rate and discount not held on the Procedure. Validator fails a missing or out-of-range selection instead of warning.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Pure module change in domain/billing with new tests; validator branch becomes a warning (DM-31); capture UI shows starting values and refreshes on Contract or code change. Depends on DM-13 and DM-09.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: The range check that fails a missing or out-of-range selected value is at validateBookingForBilling.ts:150 to :162, as stated.

dataModelDeltas.title: Pricing is one rule on values held on the Procedure: its price, else (base + time + modifier) x rate x (1 - discount); Type 2/3 pricing goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Procedure is priced by its Contract and the values held on it. If it holds a price (line fixed price, prepaid amount, or entered by someone permitted) that is the price and BTM is reference. Otherwise (B+T+M) x rate x (1 - discount), rate being the line's else the anaesthetist's unit value, discount held on the Procedure and shown as its own invoice line. Price 0 gives a no-charge invoice; submission rejected when no price can be worked out; all prices ex GST.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: feeFor: Type 1 units x unit value; Type 2 agreed rate or percent discount folded into a derived rate; Type 3 fixed ContractPrice else BTM fallback with ordinal rule; non-RVG billing lines; then typed priceOverride last. Price, rate and discount not held on the Procedure; no price source recorded.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Rewrite of the pure fee path and Vitest suite on new Procedure values with a rejection path; Procedure gains price, rate, discount filled from the line. Invoice line text must stop being the only snapshot (DM-08). Depends on DM-09 and DM-14.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Fee path structure as described; several cited US- items are Retired (US-05.2.6, US-05.4.3, US-03.5.2 status checked) and serve only as the removal boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Price changes become edits of the Procedure's own price, rate and discount: the anaesthetist where the Contract is editable and the price is not fixed or prepaid, the office on any Contract, no reason, last change stands
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Contract's editable flag says whether the anaesthetist may change price, rate or discount. Two limits override it: a fixed price never allows the anaesthetist override (OQ-117) and a prepaid Contract is never editable (OQ-96). The office can change any price on any Contract at any time. No reason needed; every change audited and flagged at review; last change stands; changing the Contract resets values; BTM still recorded.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One optional Procedure.priceOverride (fixedFee, dollarAdjustment, percentAdjustment) with mandatory reason, writable by anyone with edit rights via editProcedure; OverrideCard and PriceOverrideSheet drive it. No Contract editable flag, no actor distinction, no reset, no review flag.
dataModelDeltas.impact: priceOverride and its reason go; Procedure price/rate/discount (DM-50) edited in place with actor audited; validator and both UIs gate on Contract editable flag AND not fixed AND not prepaid for the anaesthetist, office ignores all three. 9 non-test files read priceOverride. Depends on DM-07 and DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: 9-file priceOverride count re-run and matches.

dataModelDeltas.title: Modifiers become per-Procedure records, each claimed one with an explanation; age and included modifiers are pre-applied but not locked; ASA is just a modifier
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The anaesthetist picks each modifier from the RVG modifier table plus AA's own, itemised, with a short explanation per claimed one (the only explanation asked). The system pre-applies only the age modifier (from date of birth) and modifiers included in a code's base units (P1 on Neurosurgery and Spine codes), shown selected at 0 units, none locked. Nothing pre-filled from ASA. Some modifier values are not plain numbers. Age bands and stacking are OQ-95.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.selectedModifierCodes string array plus separate asaClass seeding its AS code; modifierUnits sums plain numbers and zeroes codes in RvgCode.absorbsModifierCodes with a refusal caption. No explanation field, no age modifier from DOB, no per-Procedure modifier record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New record (procedure, modifier, units, explanation, origin chosen|age|included); modifier master gains non-numeric shapes and AA codes; RVG group's included link replaces absorbsModifierCodes; asaClass and refusal path go; completion adds explanation rule; capture sheet rebuilt. 17 non-test files. Needs DM-13; feeds DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue contradiction (locked versus not locked included modifiers, US-03.3.4 versus US-05.1.4) is already listed in the contradictions section; the not-locked reading is used.

dataModelDeltas.title: Multi-procedure rule: one primary flag, time on every procedure, modifier units split above four, no Contract-specific ordinals
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one primary Procedure per Booking. Base units only on the primary; time units on every Procedure from its own times (1 per 15 min for two hours then 1 per 10, part intervals rounded up, tiers as data). Modifier units all on the primary while the Booking total is 4 or fewer, otherwise divided evenly with the remainder to the primary. No Contract changes the rule.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Base-on-primary and time-on-every-procedure already match. Procedure.isAdditional boolean with modifiers always on the first; no settable primary, no modifier split above four; ordinal-keyed fixed prices; time tiers are module constants.

dataModelDeltas.verify_note: 15-file isAdditional count matches. US-04.2.5 and US-05.3.4 are Retired and appear only as the 'no Contract-specific ordinals' boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: The BillingLine entity, rate x time billing and the Method 3 gate are removed; other late lines become events
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Rate x time capture is Retired: a Contract with its own fixed rate prices the whole Procedure at BTM x rate. Other billing lines (post-op, nerve catheters, pain consults, transport) are Retired and merged into events. Contract add-on fees gone. Time is optional recording. A payer split is a Booking action, not a line setting (DM-28).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine with ChargeBasis rvg|fixed|rateTime, hours, rate, funderOverride; Contract.permitsIndividualArrangement as the validator-enforced Method 3 gate; seeded rate x time Booking; lines summed into the fee; add-line UI.

Build DM-17 first, then remove; do with DM-07 and DM-59 so Contract shape and validator are touched once.

dataModelDeltas.title: Authorising a List snapshots each Procedure's Contract version, line and pricing values; the billing engine reads the snapshot
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On AUTHORISED the engine snapshots per Procedure the Contract version, Procedure values (units, price, rate, discount), recorded BTM, rate and discount used, price, and payer or billable party details. Later changes to RVG groups or Contracts never alter an issued invoice, which can be reproduced. Before authorisation, values refresh from a revised line (prepaid keeps its invoiced price); how relinking meets the AUTHORISED lock is not stated.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: authoriseList only sets AUTHORISED. The billing run later resolves the Contract and computes the fee at run time and stores amounts plus rate text inside invoice line descriptions. No stored Contract version or resolved values; InvoiceLine.procedureId optional so per-Procedure ledger share is not recorded.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New PricingSnapshot per Procedure written at authorisation and read by the run and regeneration; immutable lock covers the Contract version too. Needs DM-07, DM-10, DM-50, DM-11. Per-Booking failure isolation stays. Makes issued invoices independent of the OQ-131 editing model.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: InvoiceLine.procedureId optional at types.ts:1131 and resolveContractForProcedure runs at billing time (invoiceBuild.ts:114) as described.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract carries invoice layout, GST treatment and the holder references a Booking must supply; the delivery method moves to the contract holder
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract sets invoice layout (holder or patient) and GST treatment. Delivery (email or another output) is a flag on the holder or its billable party, not a Contract setting (OQ-114). The Contract names the references its holder needs (member number, SXAP); the office supplies them on the Booking. Configurable required inputs Retired. Posted invoices for payers without email OQ-122.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Layout derived from counterparty kind at build time. A single free-text Procedure.billingReference with a completeness check. No delivery-method field; emailing is a stamp.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A few Contract fields (layout, GST) and a Booking-side reference map; completeness check moves to office review. Delivery flag built with DM-48. Depends on DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.2.7 is Retired and is cited only as the boundary for the removed configurable inputs.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure keeps the text exactly as received from each source, the rooms' and the hospital's apart, plus an invoice description set by a series of defaults (rooms, hospital, Contract line) that admins can edit
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure keeps procedure text exactly as each originating system sent it (rooms and hospital separately), never overwritten; later wording is added beside it with source and time; manual entry keeps what was typed. Booking screens show it above Contract and RVG code. A separate invoice description is set by overriding defaults (OQ-103): rooms' text, replaced by the hospital's whenever one arrives, replaced by the chosen Contract line's description where filled in; RVG code plays no part; admins can always edit it. Open: whether a later default overwrites an admin edit (OQ-130, recommend keep the edit and tell the office).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One editable free-text Procedure.description. IntegrationMessage keeps raw text but the Booking does not; no history of wordings, source system or time, no invoice description, no Contract line description to default from.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Append-only source-text list on Procedure written by every intake path (manual, integration, PDF ingest, matching screen); an editable invoiceDescription recording where its value came from; stack on all booking screens, review and matching screen; default order a pure function. Pairs with DM-13, DM-09, DM-34, DM-61.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Procedure.description is the only text field (types.ts:825); ingestPdfRow edits it in place (integrationActions.ts:453 on).

dataModelDeltas.title: Who is billed: the Contract's holder or the payer named on the Booking, replacing the per-Procedure billable-party override and the billing routes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Procedure's Contract decides who is billed: the holder's billable party when the holder pays AA, otherwise the payer on the Booking. Every Booking names a payer prefilled from the patient (name, email, postal address) and editable to another party (parent, guardian, benefactor, family trust); a billed payer needs an email or postal address; held on the Booking, kept for the life of the debt then archived; payer under 18 is a mild warning. One invoice per distinct billable party per Booking. Where the contact rule is enforced is not stated.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-Procedure billablePartyId override to a BillableParty master (guardian record) with its own Xero contact; default payer is the patient on the Billable Party route. Counterparty is a CounterpartyRef union chosen by counterpartyForProcedure. No Booking-level payer, no different-payer tick, no email-or-address rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains payer fields and a different-payer flag; counterparty resolution becomes holder billable party or Booking payer; BillableParty master repurposed as reference table; guardian master replaced by the Booking payer; contact rule needs a home; Xero contact keying stays on a hidden id. 13 non-test files read billablePartyId. Needs DM-48 and DM-10; DM-28, DM-20, DM-31 build on it.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: counterpartyForProcedure (invoiceBuild.ts:186 on) switches on billingRoute and billablePartyId as described; 13-file count matches.

dataModelDeltas.title: Splitting a Procedure's fee between payers is a Booking action with typed $ or % shares, not a line-level funder override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On a Booking the user presses a button against a Procedure to split the invoiced fee between billable parties; each share a typed $ or %, each party invoiced its share on its own invoice. A user action not a Contract setting, separate from an additional invoice. Basis is our pick (OQ-68); whether % shares total 100 is open.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine.funderOverride with a conservation rule; office-only allocation through setBillingLineAllocation and setProcedureFunderAllocation. Grouping invoices by distinct counterparty per Booking is built and aligned.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace line-level overrides with a per-Procedure shares record; validator and allocation sheet adapt; invoice grouping unchanged. Moves with DM-46. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.2.12 is Retired (its split moved to US-08.2.3) and is cited only as the origin of the removed Contract setting.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Booking carries the insurer and the insurance approval number, editable by the office and by the anaesthetist, who sees the number where there is one; a missing approval number is the only insurance warning, and insurance guides the Contract but never narrows the list or decides who is billed
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An insured Booking holds the insurer (a reference to a contract holder; no insurer master) and the approval number as Booking fields, shown on the matching screen and editable by the office and the anaesthetist (who may learn of it only on the day). A missing approval number is a warning, never a block; the anaesthetist can complete without it. SXAP says the hospital arranges cover, not approval. 23 Oct: insurance does not narrow the Contract list; the insurer-will-pay warning is dropped; the missing approval number is the only insurance warning, shown to office and anaesthetist. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-93 part 4, Donald for the build): where the Booking holds an approval number the anaesthetist sees the number itself. The number is still not needed to complete (US-03.6.1).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: None. Procedure.insurerId is the payee of the Insurer billing route into the Insurer master; accRelated is an informational flag. No approval number anywhere.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains an insurer reference (to a holder, after DM-48) and an approval number, editable by office and anaesthetist, shown on the matching screen and review and to the anaesthetist as the number itself when held; insurerId stops being a route; one warning rule lands with DM-31. The Contract picker takes no insurance filter. Small.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Grep for approval number finds only the free-text billingReference (types.ts:856); insurerId is a route payee. US-11.4.3 is Verify, in scope.

dataModelDeltas.title: The NHI is mandatory with no blank: a Booking cannot be saved without one, and an incoming row without one waits at intake
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every patient record has an NHI from creation, no blank or pending state; the NHI is the identifier and dedupe key. A Booking cannot be saved without one. An incoming booking (feed or PDF) with none waits on the matching screen's unmatched queue, creating neither Booking nor patient, until the office adds the NHI; waiting rows marked urgent as the date nears. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-118): while it waits a stub (not a Booking) shows in its place on its List, seen by the anaesthetist and the office (DM-58).

dataModelDeltas.impact: Patient.nhi required; remove the provisional path and NHI pending (16 non-test files); creation paths (manual, integration, PDF) refuse or park a row without one; waiting rows live in DM-34's unmatched queue and each draws a stub on its List (DM-58); search by NHI or name. Seed patients need checking for blank NHIs.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: nhi?: string at types.ts:173 and the createdProvisional outcome at intake.ts:29/:127 confirmed. Whether name search by NHI exists was not re-tested; kept as drafted.

dataModelDeltas.title: A single Booking moves to a colleague by creating a List in the colleague's free Slot; whoever submits a List did its procedures
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An anaesthetist can move a single Booking as well as a whole List, only to a colleague free in that Slot. The move creates a List in the colleague's Slot holding the Booking; never into an existing List; two Lists in a Slot unsupported (OQ-85). A receiver on leave first sets their Slot available. The mover may notify the admin pool or raise the update email. The List's anaesthetist did every procedure; a prepaid payable sits in the AA Holding account so nothing moves. Colleagues shown by availability alone, never ordered by tier or pairing (OQ-113).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: reassignBooking moves a Booking between Lists; an anaesthetist actor may only move between their own Lists, the office anywhere not AUTHORISED. Whole-List own move built (Phase 32) with a flat colleague list, but no single-Booking move, no creation of the receiver's List, no receiver-availability rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Anaesthetist-actor single-Booking move that creates the receiver's List in a free Slot; colleague finder reused; optional notice (DM-41). Payable repoint step gone (derived; prepaid in the holding account, DM-21).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: reassignBooking refuses an anaesthetist unless both Lists are their own and ACTIVE (lifecycle.ts:593 to :606); pushTargets is flat and surname-ordered (listMoves.ts:130 to :150).

dataModelDeltas.title: The shared notification pool gains an active or resolved state with who and when, and a second source: an anaesthetist's 'ask the office to check'
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One pool for the whole admin team, separate from the to-do list, a dashboard panel with active notices newest first and a count. Two states only, active and resolved: any admin resolves by ticking, hiding it for everyone (who and when kept; show-resolved filter), never expires; no per-user read state. Sources: an anaesthetist moving a List and an alert from an anaesthetist who is unsure about a List or Booking (US-03.6.3); a single-Booking move may notify optionally.

dataModelDeltas.impact: Notification gains resolvedAtISO and resolvedBy, a show-resolved filter, a new kind carrying a note and List or Booking link, an anaesthetist-app action and review-queue visibility; tick shared with the warnings to-do (DM-31).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: types.ts comment confirms append-only with no read or actioned state, written only by postNotification.

dataModelDeltas.title: The anaesthetist profile holds mandatory bank account details and a mandatory HPI CPN (the rest of the master data is built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Profile holds contact details, registration number, HPI CPN, bank account details held in the system (not Xero only), and the dollar value per unit; no GST period, no prepaid setting. Bank details and HPI CPN are mandatory: a record saved without either is refused. Rooms, surgeon profile, groups and hospital contact email are master data.
