dataModelDeltas.impact: Bank account field set on Anaesthetist, required-field guard on HPI CPN and bank details in the form and store action, seed values. Held in the system as the catalogue requires though the payment is made in Xero (OQ-111, 4 Nov), so it is master data the accountant's schedule can show, not a field the app pays from (DM-25). Low risk, any time.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No bank field anywhere in src (matches only in comments in DemoXero and aaFeeActions); editAnaesthetist accepts a blank HPI. A GST number for the invoice is split out as DM-62.

dataModelDeltas.title: Hospital booking downloads and the rooms' PDF lists land on a matching screen as import rows with an admin decision; unmatched rows and rows with no NHI wait in a queue
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: NEW 4 Nov: the first release builds both intake sources, each landing on the same review-and-merge screen (OQ-108, Donald for the build; replaces the 20 Oct rule that the hospital download came first): hospital bookings however each hospital provides them, and the rooms' PDF lists read and ingested (DM-61). It also syncs both integrated hospitals into the screen (OQ-109 part 2 assumed; which two hospitals is open, St George's and Southern Cross or Forte). Per row the admin matches to a List and Booking, creates a Booking on an existing List, creates a List in a Slot, creates a Draft List, or rejects; a later update to a matched Booking shows field differences for approval; each row shows its text as received. Unmatched rows and rows with no NHI wait in the unmatched queue (with a stub on the List, DM-58); nothing applied silently. Automatic schedule, pull on open, sync button, last-synced removed. Removal detection (US-02.2.3), inbound changes until authorised (US-02.5.4), automatic matching and other providers stay Future Work.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Simulated HL7 and FHIR messages applied straight to Bookings by processMessage with statuses, retry and dead-letter in an IntegrationMessage log; ingestPdfRow ingests a canned PDF row straight onto a chosen List, creating or updating a Booking at once. Integration writes gated only by List state. hospitalRow reserved as a Draft List origin but nothing emits it. No import row, match decision, difference view or unmatched queue.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New ImportRow and MatchDecision entities and a queue screen; Booking writes from feeds and PDFs move behind approval; HL7/FHIR message log demoted (FT-14.1, FT-14.2 Future) or becomes the row source. Two sources share one row shape (source, text as received, link to message or PDF) so the screen is built once. Slot, List and Draft List it creates into are built. Needs DM-51 and DM-30; DM-61 supplies PDF rows, DM-58 the stub.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: ingestPdfRow creates or edits at once (integrationActions.ts:453 to :500) and editRefusal lets an integration actor write to any ACTIVE List (lifecycle.ts:55 to :63). US-02.1.5 and US-02.2.1 are in scope (not Retired, not in the Future Work lane); US-02.2.3 and US-02.5.4 are Future Work and stay boundary only.

dataModelDeltas.title: A stub stands in a List for an incoming booking that could not be posted, held on an identifier other than the NHI
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: When an incoming booking for a List cannot become a Booking (e.g. no NHI), a stub shows in its place on that List and the List's other Bookings are added as usual. OQ-118 ANSWERED 4 Nov (Donald, for the build, not yet seen by Vanessa or Ben): 'Yes, we will have stubs', seen by the anaesthetist and the office. A stub is not a Booking, so the no-NHI-no-Booking rule (OQ-49) still holds and the row waits at intake. Held on an identifier other than the NHI. The office resolves it from the unmatched queue and the Booking then takes the stub's place (our reading, not said by AA). What a stub shows is still to be worked out. FT-02.6 moved Open to Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. A row without an NHI becomes a Booking on a provisional patient (createdProvisional) and the UI prints NHI pending; no stub, placeholder or intake queue, so a List missing a booking looks complete.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A Stub record on the List (id, List, source row ref, reason, text as received) held outside the Bookings table, drawn in both anaesthetist apps and the Admin List view with a problem mark, replaced by the Booking on resolution. Needs DM-30; takes rows from DM-34's unmatched queue; before DM-34 the integration path can create it. No longer held for OQ-118; confirm what a stub shows and the replace-on-resolution reading. Seed one demo List with a stub; PERSIST_VERSION bump.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: OQ-118 status is answered (4) and FT-02.6 is Verify, so the delta is no longer held. Grep finds no stub or placeholder entity; a no-NHI row goes through upsertPatient to a provisional patient.

dataModelDeltas.title: A surgeon's PDF list is a source document: an inbox of emailed lists, rows read from it, corrected before ingest, landing on the matching screen
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins upload an emailed PDF list of a surgeon's bookings; the system reads it and extracts the bookings for review, and before ingest the admin can correct fields such as an invalid NHI (US-02.2.1, merging Retired US-02.2.2). Rooms re-send the whole List on every change up to the procedure day; treating a later PDF for the same List as an update to merge is our reading (match key unstated). Each extracted row lands on the same matching screen as a hospital row with differences shown for approval (US-02.1.3). The row text is the rooms' text as received (DM-51). Left Future Work on 4 Nov with OQ-108 (Donald for the build); removal detection (US-02.2.3) and inbound changes until authorised (US-02.5.4) stay Future Work.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A demo-only inbox: SurgeonPdf and PdfRow fixtures (canned facsimile, one deliberately wrong NHI) shown in the Integration Monitor's PDF tab with an edit-then-ingest review. ingestPdfRow validates the NHI, then updates a Booking already on the chosen List with that NHI or creates one with source surgeonPdf, immediately. Files are fixtures outside the store: no stored document, upload, received date or sender, row status, link from a Booking to its PDF, or merge of a re-sent List through a matching screen.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A SurgeonPdfList record in the store (file or facsimile, sender room or surgeon, received time, target List suggestion, status, extracted rows with corrections) with an admin upload action replacing the fixtures; its rows become DM-34 import rows with the rooms as source, so the PDF tab's direct ingest goes away and a matched re-sent List shows differences; NHI correction moves onto the matching screen's row editor. Simulated parsing stays. Source link feeds DM-51's text as received. Built with DM-34; needs DM-51; PERSIST_VERSION bump.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: PdfRow and SurgeonPdf are fixture types in domain/integrations, not store entities; ingestPdfRow also hard-codes billingRoute 'hospital' and a blank-NHI row becomes a provisional patient. Overlaps DM-34 on the row shape but adds the stored source document, so kept separate.

dataModelDeltas.title: Explicit-save change sets, an on-demand update email draft picked from the change history, and email templates
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin saves Booking edits explicitly; each save records fields changed (before, after, who, when) in the append-only history. A Booking's admin screen has an on-demand draft update email: the admin picks changes and a mailto window opens prefilled (subject, boilerplate, changes, To address: hospital contact for a cover change, surgeon's room for a Booking change), about 2,000 characters, nothing sent or recorded. Cover-change email offered from a List-move notice. Templates configurable per kind of change. Automatic sending is Future.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Append-only audit per mutation not grouped into save sets; edits apply immediately; no email draft, no templates. Contact emails it needs exist (hospital and room).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Change-set grouping on audit entries (or a draft buffer), an email-draft launcher and a template master; admin edit form becomes explicit-save. Launched from DM-41 notices. For a surgeon at more than one room (DM-60) which room's email is the To address is OQ-127 part 5, so the launcher shows the rooms and lets the admin choose until answered.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No mailto or template code found in src. US-02.5.5 is in scope (stays in MVP per its own note).

dataModelDeltas.title: Reference data: a master public-holiday calendar, a repeatable one-off data load and maintenance screens for the new masters
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place: hospitals with contact email, surgeons and groups, rooms, anaesthetists, Slot statuses, recurring bookings, master and per-hospital holiday calendars, RVG groups, modifiers, contract holders, Contracts with lines. Loaded once by a developer-run, repeatable data load, then hand-edited with audit; clean cut, no migration. Contract schedule upload is Future Work.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Master Data has CRUD for hospitals, anaesthetists, surgeons, rooms, statuses, recurring bookings, holidays and Contracts. RVG code and Modifier code views are view-only tables with no write action. Holidays per hospital only, no master calendar; seed data are TypeScript fixtures; no data-load script; the 3 Nov specialist list is a generated fixture.
dataModelDeltas.impact: CRUD for new masters (RVG groups DM-13, holders DM-48, Contracts DM-07/DM-09, modifiers DM-44), a master holiday calendar feeding each hospital's, optionally a repeatable load script. Mostly follows the entity deltas.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: HospitalHoliday carries hospitalId only (types.ts:1000); US-13.4.1 names a master (public holiday) calendar. US-04.2.13 is the Future Work boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Warning routine: the model and the dashboard to-do list are built; the remaining rules land as their source entities do
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One routine raises warnings (before or after procedure, mild or strong, never blocking): unpaid prepayment, billable patient with a balance, child as payer, base units outside range, insured Booking with no approval number (shown to office and to the anaesthetist viewing the Booking). The insurer-will-pay warning was dropped 23 Oct. Patient balance alert also shows to the anaesthetist on the Booking in their List. Shown as a dashboard to-do an admin clears and a warning triangle in both apps; no confirm step on submit. Settings are Future.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built (Phases 15a, 15a2): Warning, WarningRule, WarningClearance, AppSettings, one registered rule prepaymentUnpaid, stored office clearance, derived warnings read by the dashboard to-do and a Booking flag in both apps.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Only the rules remain, each widening WarningRuleId as its source lands: child payer (DM-11), missing approval number (DM-12), out-of-range units (DM-43), billable patient with a balance (DM-23). Dashboard tick also resolves notices (DM-41). A Contract changed by the anaesthetist is an audit and review flag (DM-10), not a warning.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: WarningRuleId is the single literal 'prepaymentUnpaid' (warnings/types.ts:20).

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepayment: started by picking a prepaid Contract, amount is the line's price, invoice generated when an admin approves it (an optional step), prepaid Procedures left off the final invoice with nothing deducted, and a Contract changed off prepaid cancels the prepayment
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Picking a Contract flagged prepaid starts the prepayment, per Procedure, re-checked when Procedures, Contract or payer change. The amount is the full price on that Contract's line (above zero), never a deposit; the Contract is never editable by the anaesthetist. Invoice generated when an admin approves it (optional step AA can switch off); pair is a receivable from the Booking payer and a payable to the AA Holding account (DM-21). A prepaid Procedure keeps its invoiced price if the Contract's price changes. After authorisation the prepaid amount is the price; no automatic invoice or credit; extra or lesser work is a hand-raised second invoice or credit. The final invoice leaves every prepaid Procedure off and deducts nothing (OQ-116). Unpaid is a warning not a gate. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-119, Donald for the build): changing a prepaid Procedure's Contract to one not flagged prepaid after the prepayment is sent or paid is handled as a cancellation: refunded in full if paid, credited if unpaid (our reading), receivable and holding-account payable reversed, then invoiced under the new Contract after the procedure. Open: whether the invoice names the anaesthetist (OQ-120), release trigger (OQ-125).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Prepayment is Procedure.patientPaymentCategory selfFundedPrepayment plus prepaymentDetail full or split, derived on the Billable Party route. The office raises the pre-procedure invoice by hand with no approval step or setting; a split deposit is a flat figure with the balance billed at the run and a visible netting deduction line; a full prepayment invoices an estimated fee, not a Contract price. Status derived and the unpaid warning built (aligned).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove PrepaymentDetail, the split path, the payment category and the netting deduction line; the run skips prepaid Procedures while ranking all; trigger and amount read from the prepaid Contract's line (needs DM-07, DM-09, DM-11 guards); Invoice gains a held-for-approval state under a switchable setting and a letter-template master. The Contract-change guard now has a rule: changing off prepaid once sent or paid calls the same credit or refund as a cancellation (DM-21, DM-24), then the run invoices under the new Contract. OQ-120 stays open. Before DM-21.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: PrepaymentDetail full|split and PatientPaymentCategory confirmed (types.ts:794 to :805). FT-06.4 and US-06.4.2 style items are Retired and not relied on.

dataModelDeltas.title: AA Holding account: the prepayment's payable is a creditor in the payables sub-ledger, and a journal transfer moves it to the anaesthetist who did the List at authorisation
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A prepayment's payable side is the AA Holding account, a creditor in the payables sub-ledger beside each anaesthetist, not a bank or Xero ledger account; its balance is all prepayments for procedures not yet done; the money sits in the trust account. It is never paid itself. Prepayment is two steps: collect against the account, then at authorisation a journal transfer (not a payment) moves it to the anaesthetist who did the List. Cancelling a prepaid Booking, or (NEW 4 Nov, OQ-119) changing its Contract off prepaid after sending or payment, automatically credits the invoice if unpaid or refunds it in full if paid, raised by the system (OQ-115). Money leaves the account only through the system (transfer or refund the system raises); NEW 4 Nov (OQ-111, Donald for the build): the payments themselves, anaesthetists' and the cash of a refund (the latter follows from 'all payments', not said separately), are made in Xero and tracked by the system. A moved prepaid Booking changes nothing in the ledger. Open: release trigger (OQ-125).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holding account. Soft cancel keeps the Booking and charges no fee but credits and refunds nothing. The prepayment's ACCPAY is to the anaesthetist and released pro rata as money is received, so the anaesthetist can be paid before the procedure.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A fixed ledger creditor record for the AA Holding account as payee; the release rule holds the prepayment payable until authorisation then writes the transfer pair to the List's anaesthetist; cancelling a prepaid Booking or moving it off prepaid calls an automatic credit or refund (needs DM-24); only system actions may move money out (transfer, credit, refund), the cash payment being a Xero-side event the system detects; draft Xero pair to a holding-account contact; balance in the ledger position (DM-23). Needs DM-20 and DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: payableRelease.ts releases pro rata as money arrives; soft cancel at lifecycle.ts:362 writes no credit or refund.

dataModelDeltas.title: Events on a Procedure (pre-op, post-op, billing event, additional invoice, credit, refund) replace the post-op addendum Booking and the other billing lines
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An event is anything recorded against a Procedure after it is set up: its own element listed on the Procedure in both apps. Pre-op and post-op events carry their own date and time, record a time or fixed fee, take no other modifiers, with an invoice tick and a same-as-Procedure's-billable-party tick. A billing event is a free-form charge or credit; former other billing lines merged in; a refund can show as one. Events appear on no List or schedule; they live with the Booking. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-121, Donald for the build, not yet seen by Vanessa): a billable event is billed in the next billing run and never held for the Procedure's own invoice, through one review step: on the same invoice as other lines for the same billable party in that run where it can, otherwise an invoice of its own, no rules by kind. Replaces part of OQ-63's answer. Covers pain management and ACC pre-op (codes OQ-12 open).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A post-op addendum is a new linked Booking (bookingType postOpAddendum, addendumOfBookingId) running its own capture, submit, authorise and bill cycle. Late fee lines are BillingLines added before invoicing. No event record, invoice tick, billable-party tick or next-run rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Event entity (procedure, kind, date and time, time or fixed fee, invoiced flag, billable party or same-as, invoice link); replaces the addendum Booking (6 non-test files) and the post-invoice billing-line path; the run picks up every invoiced event not yet billed, groups it with other lines for the same billable party in that run, or raises an invoice of its own; nothing held for or joined to a Procedure's unapproved invoice; one review step; both apps list them. After DM-10 and DM-08; DM-18 and DM-24 are event kinds; DM-46's removal waits on this.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: 6-file postOpAddendum count matches. US-03.7.1 to US-03.7.3 and US-05.5.2 carry Agreed status, in scope.

dataModelDeltas.title: Additional invoice: a free-form invoice recorded as an event, to any billable party, always an invoice of its own with its own ledger pair
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin (any Procedure) or the anaesthetist (their own) adds a free-form invoice (description, quantity, amount; no Contract or unit rules) to any billable party, traceable both ways to the original, recorded as an event, through the standard review step. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-121): it is always an invoice of its own, with its own number, ledger pair, Xero pair and anaesthetist payable, billed in the next run like every event; the earlier 'a line on the original if raised before approval' branch is gone. Uses: late charges, extra work after prepaid or fixed-price work, splitting a combined Procedure (credit note then additional invoices totalling the credited amount).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Invoice.kind standard|prePayment with a bookingId and no link to an original invoice or Procedure; priced lines only (InvoiceLine.procedureId optional). No free-form entry and no second-invoice lineage.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Invoice.kind widens (additional, credit note) with originalInvoiceId and procedureId; free-form line entry UI in both apps; the same pair creation and Xero handoff as any invoice; an additional invoice never joins another invoice. Needs DM-17 and DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Invoice.kind is 'standard' | 'prePayment' only (types.ts:1120). US-11.3.3 is cited for notes and needs no model change.

dataModelDeltas.title: A wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; the payable is reversed by a negative invoice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An invoice is never edited or partly adjusted: it is credited in full (to any party) and a corrected invoice raised, each traceable; ledger payable and Xero pair reversed and re-created together. The reversal is a negative invoice to the anaesthetist, netted in their next payment run and shown on the remittance advice. A credit note is not a refund. The rebill may start from a draft copy. Credit and new invoices are events. Cancelling a prepaid Booking, or moving a Procedure off prepaid after sending, raises its credit or refund automatically.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing: no credit note, negative payable or rebill; invoices immutable once raised; BillingPipelineStatus has no credited or reversed state.
dataModelDeltas.impact: CreditNote entity linked to its invoice, negative payable record and Xero credit mirroring, rebill-from-copy action, new BillingCase states. Needs DM-18 and DM-22; precedes DM-25's netting and DM-21's refund; DM-20's refund on a Contract change calls it too.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No credit note or negative-payable type exists in src.

dataModelDeltas.title: The internal ledger holds both halves of each pair as its own records (including the holding-account payable), with the payable independent of Xero
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: For every invoice the engine creates a linked receivable from the billable party and a payable to the anaesthetist in its own ledger (system of record), which Xero only mirrors as ACCREC and draft ACCPAY (a prepayment's payable is to the holding account). Tracks money in and out per patient and per anaesthetist, survives Xero contact archiving. Payable carries the receivable's number with -P; each payable a buyer-created tax invoice (count OQ-29). Structured as control accounts (debtors, creditors) with sub-ledgers (patients; anaesthetists and the AA Holding account) reconciled; trust account is the bank account. Xero or system sending invoices is a build choice.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Ledger is the billing slice (Invoice, InvoiceLine, BillingCase with received, authorised and disbursed amounts and Xero ids), which the code calls a mirror. The payable document and amounts exist only as XeroAccPay in the Xero simulation, so the payable has no ledger record of its own. -P number stored; no buyer-created tax invoice wording.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Promote the Payable into the ledger (id, number, amount, authorised, disbursed, status, payee anaesthetist or holding account) with Xero downstream; split BillingCase into receivable and payable sides; rewire payments, payables run, selectors and Xero view; control accounts with patient and creditors sub-ledgers reconciled (DM-23). Payments to anaesthetists are made in Xero and tracked here (OQ-111, DM-25), so the disbursed side records what the system detects. Foundation for DM-21, DM-18, DM-24, DM-23, DM-25, DM-29.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: The ACCPAY exists as a Xero-slice record that payablesActions mutates; the ledger has no payable record. The anaesthetist's GST number on the receivable (US-08.4.5) is split out as DM-62.

dataModelDeltas.title: Derived ledger positions for the whole ledger, per anaesthetist and per patient; a flat outstanding list without ageing; patient balance alerts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Admin App shows the ledger position for the whole ledger (receivables, receipts held, payables due, disbursed, imbalance), a single anaesthetist, and a patient's outstanding across anaesthetists. The anaesthetist's outstanding list is flat, oldest first, with no ageing buckets. Booking or matching a patient with a balance alerts staff: mild under the threshold (90 days from invoice date), strong above, mild for credit; never a block; follow-ups recorded. Anaesthetists see the patient alert on the Booking in their List. Also trust account by anaesthetist due, and any sub-ledger to control account difference.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-anaesthetist outstanding list per ACCPAY with agingDays and a bucket (which the catalogue excludes). A boolean patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode shown as Prior balance in the billing monitor; no threshold, mild or strong. No whole-ledger, per-anaesthetist or per-patient screen; no follow-up record; no alert reaches the anaesthetist's List.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New pure selectors over the ledger and three admin views; remove ageing buckets from web Accounts and dashboard; threshold in appSettings; FollowUpAction record. Needs DM-22 and DM-11; alert rule in DM-31; alert on the Booking row in both anaesthetist apps; reconciliation view.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: agingDays and bucketForAgingDays at selectors.ts:874 to :907 and the boolean prior-balance check at :552 confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Weekly payment cycle with period approval of BCTIs and a remittance advice that nets negative invoices; the payment is made in Xero and tracked
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A payable is released when its receivable is paid, for exactly the amount received. Payments run on a weekly ISO-week cycle: Friday ledger closed and snapshotted, Monday office clears problems, Tuesday schedule of released payables goes to the accountant, anomalies roll over. BCTIs for a period are approved before the run (who approves is open). Remittance advice shows invoices paid and negative invoices netted. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-111, Donald for the build): the payment itself is made in Xero's payables run; the system detects it (webhook or daily poll) and records the disbursement against the ledger payable and does not make the payment (US-09.2.4). The system produces the schedule then tracks what Xero pays.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: runPayables pays every authorised-minus-disbursed amount at once under a payablesRunId. No cycle or week identity, approval state, held-out anomalies, remittance advice or netting. The payment is made inside the app today: the Billing Monitor's Run payables and the demo Xero panel's per-payable pay both call the in-app action that marks the payable disbursed.
dataModelDeltas.impact: PaymentRun entity (ISO week, status, held-out items), approval state on payables, remittance document, netting of negative payables. Move the pay action to the Xero simulator and record the disbursement as detected (source webhook or poll, as receivePayment already carries); replace the office's Run payables with the schedule export; bank details on the profile (DM-32) are held but not used to pay. Needs DM-24 and DM-22. Proposed in the catalogue, so keep it replaceable.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed: runPayables is office-only and disburses all eligible (payablesActions.ts:147), the Billing Monitor calls it (:55) and DemoXero.tsx:253 calls disbursePayable. US-10.2.7 is Proposed.

dataModelDeltas.title: The GST report lists the payments AA passed to the anaesthetist in the month; the anaesthetist's GST period goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each month each anaesthetist gets a list of the payments AA passed to them in the month, with the GST component of each, for their GST return. It lists payments not invoices sent; outstanding falls into a later month. Downloadable, emailable, printable (web). No GST period on the profile (US-12.1.2 Retired). All prices held ex GST.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingReceipt carries a GST component of amounts received into AA; the web Accounts GST report reads those receipts. Anaesthetist.gstPeriod monthly|biMonthly|sixMonthly is held and edited (10 non-test files).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Re-base the report on payments made to the anaesthetist (the payable's paid side from DM-22) grouped by calendar month; remove gstPeriod, its seed values and editor. Follows DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Anaesthetist.gstPeriod at types.ts:215 and 10-file count confirmed. US-12.1.2 is Retired and is the boundary for the removal.

dataModelDeltas.title: Audit covers invoices, credit notes, master data and Contract changes but not disbursements, payments or receipts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The audit trail shows who or what made each audited change: creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices, credit notes, master data and Contract and time-entry changes. Disbursements, payments and receipts are not audited there since they are recorded in Xero; depth is for the developers.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Every mutation is audited through mutate(), including simulated Xero payments and disbursements (xero.paymentReceived, xero.accpayAuthorised, xero.disbursed).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Not a structural gap: the prototype audits a superset, so nothing has to change. A policy note: keep audit uniform in the demo or filter payment and disbursement entries from the viewer. Credit notes (DM-24) and Contract versions (DM-07) must be audited.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Audit actions confirmed at paymentActions.ts:186 and :193 and payablesActions.ts:132. Kept as a policy note only; no build work follows, so it can be dropped from any plan without loss.

dataModelDeltas.title: A SUBMITTED List stays editable by the anaesthetist until AUTHORISED, and a List leaves the anaesthetist's main view at AUTHORISED
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Once SUBMITTED the anaesthetist can still see and change its Bookings until the office authorises it; changes audited and seen at review; last change stands. Submitting only tells the office it has work and makes the List less prominent. The main view shows upcoming work, earlier Lists not yet authorised and submitted ones not yet authorised; an authorised List leaves the main view (not at submit, not when billed, not on payment), its invoices show as outstanding balances, and it stays findable by search. AUTHORISED stays immutable.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: editRefusal refuses an anaesthetist once a List is SUBMITTED. A List leaves the anaesthetist's forward views when the billing run stamps List.billedAtISO, not at AUTHORISED.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Relax the anaesthetist edit rule to ACTIVE and SUBMITTED (16 non-test files name SUBMITTED), keep AUTHORISED locked, make anaesthetist edits to a SUBMITTED List visible at review; switch the forward-view filter from billedAtISO to AUTHORISED and keep search for older work. billedAtISO stays for the office monitor.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: editRefusal returns 'listSubmitted' for a non-ACTIVE own List (lifecycle.ts:68 to :70) and isListBilled drives the view filter (selectors.ts:390 comment: vanish at invoice generation, not AUTHORISED).

dataModelDeltas.title: An anaesthetist's unavailability is never a conflict: conflicts cover hospital closures only
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A List conflicts only when its hospital is closed: a soft warning, never a block. An anaesthetist's unavailability, short-notice sickness included, is never a conflict flag: a List never stays with an unavailable anaesthetist, who returns it to the office or assigns it to a colleague there and then, choosing what the vacated Slot becomes. A recurring booking landing on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ListConflict kind availability|holiday; conflicts.ts derives an availability conflict for a List in a closed Slot. The anaesthetist's own path is guarded (return or assign, Phase 32), but the office's sickness-record path keeps the List with the availability conflict as provisional.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove the availability conflict kind and its derivation; the office recording sickness must also force a return or assign (or send the List to Draft Lists); Conflicts screen and dashboard shrink to holiday closures; tests and the sickness demo trigger rewritten. Independent of every other delta.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: holdsListRefusal docs (availabilityActions.ts:154 to :158) say the office path keeps the derived conflict; simulateSickness uses the office actor (demoSimulations.ts:49). US-01.5.2 is Agreed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract changes are staged, reviewed on a dashboard and submitted together as a new dated version
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The office maintains one Contract at a time on a header and lines screen. Edits are staged and shown on a review dashboard (header before and after, counts of lines added, altered, removed, unchanged, each altered line's values, blocking errors such as duplicate codes or a missing or past effective date, non-blocking warnings such as affected Bookings); the office sets the effective date and submits together, all or nothing, creating the new dated version. A one-line fix follows the same path. Upload in the AA template is Future. NEW 4 Nov: whether the office keeps Contracts as whole-Contract dated versions (what this builds), a date per line, or in-place edits with audit is OQ-131; US-04.2.10 and US-04.2.14 went Agreed to Open.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: contractActions edits a Contract and its price rows in place, immediately, with an audit entry. No staged change set, diff or effective-date step.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A staged ContractChange per Contract applied only on submit, a pure diff builder and the review dashboard; submit creates the version through DM-07 and runs the relink and affected-Booking list. After DM-07 and DM-09. HOLD until OQ-131: whole-Contract versions need this; a date per line shrinks it to a line editor; in-place editing with audit needs none of it (current behaviour plus a diff view). Upload stays out.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: OQ-131 is Open (status 1) and US-04.1.6 is Proposed; hold is right. US-04.2.13 is the Future Work boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: The completion gate is three conditions: a Contract, times where the Contract prices from time, and an explanation for each claimed modifier; the billing validator no longer decides completion
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Before the anaesthetist can mark a Booking complete every Procedure must have a Contract, times recorded where the Contract prices from time (not fixed price), and a short explanation for any claimed modifier. RVG code optional; the holder's references are the office's job; the insurance approval number is not needed to complete (NEW 4 Nov: the anaesthetist sees it where held and may change it on the day; missing is a warning not a block). A Procedure the anaesthetist cannot complete is sent to the office. Submission is rejected when no price can be worked out. Incomplete Bookings are listed.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: completionBlockersFor delegates the whole gate to validateBookingForBilling, the same pre-flight the billing run uses, so completion is blocked by about a dozen billing-setup checks (explicit route, RVG code or billing line, times, in-range selected base value, insurer accepting direct claims, payment category and prepayment detail, Method 3 gate, override reason, conservation, hospital reference). No modifier explanation check and no times-only-where-time-priced test.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace the validator's route, insurer, category, prepayment, Method 3, override-reason and conservation branches with the three-condition rule; split completion (completionBlockersFor) from billing pre-flight (no price can be worked out, DM-50). Out-of-range units and a missing approval number become warnings (DM-31, DM-12). Mobile submit sheet and BookingDetailBody read the same failures; validator suite rewritten. Needs DM-10, DM-44, DM-13; done with DM-46.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: The validator checks listed (route, RVG or line, times, range, insurer direct claims) were read at validateBookingForBilling.ts:125 to :175; no modifier explanation exists.

dataModelDeltas.title: The surgeons' room master tolerates a missing email, a surgeon belongs to one or more rooms, and rooms gain practice manager and PA contacts (where they belong is open)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A room is master data holding its contacts. NEW 4 Nov (OQ-128, Donald for the build, not yet seen by Vanessa): a surgeon belongs to one or more rooms; the 'one room per surgeon' recommendation is gone and the ERD link is one or more. Which room's contacts apply to a Booking for a surgeon at several rooms is unanswered, part 5 of OQ-127. Ben's 3 Nov list: most practices give one shared inbox, 16 rooms no email (some no phone), so a room may be loaded with no email and a drafted update email then has an empty To address. Admin want practice manager and PA contacts (name, email) on the surgeon profile (US-13.6.5, Open); whether they belong to the room, a surgeon or either is OQ-127. Address book OQ-126. Four surgeons sit at two practices and can now be held at both; the list has no HPI CPNs (OQ-129).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: SurgeonRoom with a required contactEmail and a phone string; the room form refuses an empty or implausible email (cleanRoomFields, surgeonActions.ts:115 to :123), so no room can be saved without an email, but a blank phone is already accepted (only trimmed; the directory seed holds rooms with phone ''). Surgeon has optional specialty, one required roomId (room's surgeons derived from it; 10 non-test files read it), required hpiId, optional registration number. No contact list, PA or practice manager. The specialist directory seed (40 rooms, 131 surgeons) writes reception@ placeholder emails and fictional HPI CPNs because the model requires them, and takes the smaller practice for the four two-practice surgeons.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Optional email now (contactEmail optional, launcher tolerates an empty To; the phone already is). Surgeon.roomId becomes a list of one or more room ids (surgeon form, profile, rooms view, audit field labels, seed, derived room-to-surgeons lookup change); the directory seed loads the four surgeons at both rooms; which room's email is the To address is OQ-127 part 5 so the launcher (DM-35) lets the admin choose. A contacts list (name, email, role, owner room or surgeon) is the only new entity and waits on OQ-127; address book waits on OQ-126. Placeholder emails then dropped; PERSIST_VERSION bump. Independent of every other delta.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft said no room can be saved without a phone; the code only validates the email and blank phones already load (specialistDirectory.ts:26), so only the email half of the tolerance is a change. Title, prototype paragraph and impact fixed; the many-rooms and contacts parts and the size stand.

dataModelDeltas.title: The receivable invoice is presented in the anaesthetist's own name with their GST number, AA as agent; the profile holds no GST number
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Billing/Invoice Engine presents each receivable invoice in the anaesthetist's own name, with the anaesthetist's GST number, and identifies AA on the invoice as agent rather than as the supplier (US-08.4.5, Proposed); the ACCPAY is expected to stand as the buyer-created tax invoice carrying whatever wording that treatment needs (US-09.1.4). The whole agency treatment is pending OQ-29 for AA's accountant. The anaesthetist profile stories (US-12.1.4, US-12.1.1) list no GST number, so the catalogue does not yet say where it is held.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Anaesthetist (types.ts:209) holds no GST number. The invoice document is headed with AA's logo and 'TAX INVOICE', shows the anaesthetist's name only as a meta field and prints 'Billed by Anaesthesia Associates as agent for {name}' (InvoiceDocument.tsx:142) with no number. A comment on the Admin anaesthetist record (AnaesthetistRecord.tsx:22) anticipates a GST number field.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Small and held: an optional Anaesthetist.gstNumber (master data form, seed), the invoice document showing the anaesthetist as supplier with the number and AA as agent, and the BCTI wording on the payable (with DM-22). Hold the wording until OQ-29 is answered; the field can go in with DM-32. Independent of the pricing track.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Missed by the author: the agency treatment was only mentioned inside DM-22 as 'no buyer-created tax invoice wording', not the receivable's supplier identity or the GST number field. Catalogue inconsistency noted in the contradictions section.

deltaSummary: Verified 43 earlier deltas against the catalogue at a68f09b and the code (aa-prototype/ unchanged since d436947, PERSIST_VERSION 26): 42 upheld, 1 corrected, 1 added, none refuted or dropped. Corrected DM-60: the draft said a room cannot be saved without a phone, but the room form validates only the email (cleanRoomFields, surgeonActions.ts:115 to :123) and the directory seed already holds rooms with a blank phone (specialistDirectory.ts:26). Only the email needs to become optional. Added DM-62 (S, held on OQ-29): US-08.4.5 puts the anaesthetist's GST number on the receivable invoice in their own name with AA as agent. The profile has no GST number and the invoice prints AA as agent with no number (InvoiceDocument.tsx:142). Status checks: no in-scope claim rests on a Retired item or a Future Work story; the Retired and Future Work items cited (US-05.1.6, US-04.2.12, US-04.2.7, US-04.2.5, US-05.3.4, US-03.3.6, US-03.3.7, US-04.4.1, US-04.4.2, US-12.1.2, US-04.2.13, US-02.2.3, US-02.5.4) serve as removal or scope boundaries only. File counts quoted in the deltas (22, 44, 10, 26, 14, 9, 15, 13, 10, 16, 6) re-run and match. DM-45 is kept as a policy note only, since no build work follows from it. Total is now 44 deltas (ChangedEntity 15, S 5). domain-model-delta.md was updated with the DM-60 fix, the DM-62 section and index row, the summary and verification paragraphs, a sign-in note under the prototype-only section and a GST-number bullet under the contradictions section.

reverseFindings.title: Attachments on Bookings and Lists are fully built
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.1.3 was Retired 16 October (no requirement; Ben does not want the rooms' PDFs on a Booking). The prototype still lets the anaesthetist attach files to any Booking and List on mobile and web, the office sees them in the session drawer, a theatre-list PDF is seeded and S1 touches it.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.1.3 status 6 with a real withdrawal note (Greg: comfortable removing it). Attachments section and List attachments panel confirmed at the cited lines; seeded AT0001 confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: GST period is a per-anaesthetist setting and a selector on the report
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.1.2 is Retired (no GST period on the profile; GST report is monthly). The prototype stores gstPeriod on every anaesthetist, asks for it when adding or editing one, seeds Dr Whitaker six-monthly, and the web GST report has a Monthly / Bi-monthly / Six-monthly switch.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.1.2 status 6 ('no GST period on the profile', Greg: 'way too complicated'); US-12.2.2 says monthly. Code confirmed incl. cast.ts sixMonthly for Whitaker and AnaesthetistRecord display.

reverseFindings.title: Rate x time billing line and the Method 3 individual-arrangement gate
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.3.7 retired into US-03.3.6, itself Retired (other billing lines merge into Events; a fixed-rate Contract needs no billing line, OQ-89). The prototype still offers an hours x hourly rate line gated by a permits-individual-arrangement Contract flag, with a seeded hourly Contract and rate x time Bookings. Fixed-amount ancillary lines also remain and can stay until Events are built.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.3.6 notes say the unit x rate line 'is removed' (OQ-89) and its examples moved to Events. Gate, seeded Aria hourly Contract, rateTimeBooking seed markers and the Contract edit switch all confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Anaesthetist price adjustment: reason mandatory, offered on every Contract including prepaid and fixed prices, no per-Contract flag
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.5.3 (reason) is Retired into US-03.5.1: no reason needed, and a per-Contract flag decides what the anaesthetist can change. 28 October added: never on a prepaid Contract (OQ-96) and never on a fixed price (OQ-117). The prototype demands a reason, offers override on every Contract, and has no flag.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.5.1 text and ACs read directly: 'No reason is needed', fixed price never open to override, prepaid not editable. Code: reason mandatory in OverrideCard, PriceOverrideSheet ('Reason (required)') and the validator; no per-Contract editable flag exists.

reverseFindings.title: Prepayment is a per-Booking payment category with split deposit or estimated full fee, netted from the final invoice, no settlement on cancel
reverseFindings.explanation: Live model: per-Procedure trigger by a prepaid Contract (US-06.2.1), fixed price above zero, not editable by the anaesthetist, optional admin approval, prepaid Procedure left off the final invoice with nothing deducted (OQ-116), automatic credit or refund on cancel (OQ-115). The prototype uses a payment category, full or split deposit, a BTM estimate, deducts the deposit as a negative line, bills the balance, and cancelling settles nothing (a cancelled Booking just raises no prepayment invoice).
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-06.4.1, US-06.2.1, OQ-115, OQ-116 and OQ-96 read directly and say exactly this. Trigger (billableParty + selfFundedPrepayment), PrepaymentDetail full/split, 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line and cancel handling all confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Protected default Type 1 Contract per hospital and direct-claim insurer, auto-created and used as a fallback
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-04.4 and US-04.4.1 (Retired) mandated a default Contract per hospital and insurer; US-04.3.3 replaces them: no hospital, insurer or procedure defaults, the one default is No contract (RVG), held by AA. The prototype mints a protected Type 1 default with each hospital and direct-claim insurer, forbids deleting or end-dating it, and falls back to it when a Procedure has no valid Contract.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.3.3 says 'There are no hospital, insurer or procedure default Contracts, and nothing is derived from the List's location.' Code confirmed (isDefault true on create, DEFAULT_PROTECTED_MESSAGE, defaultContractFor fallback).

reverseFindings.title: Second-procedure pricing keyed on the procedure ordinal
reverseFindings.explanation: US-04.2.5 and US-05.3.4 are Retired (5 October, Donald): Contracts do not define second-procedure pricing; the RVG default applies (OQ-90). The prototype lets an admin key a Type 3 price row to a procedure ordinal, prices an add-on from it only when the row has an ordinal, and seeds a $950 second-procedure price.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Both retire notes state a real withdrawal, not a merge of the behaviour. Code confirmed (CP-BAR-3 ordinal 2 at $950, ordinal specificity match, fee.ts add-on exception).

reverseFindings.title: Additional procedures carry no modifier share; the above-four split is missing
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.3.3 retired into US-05.3.1 (confirmed 19 October): modifier units on the primary while four or fewer, then split equally with remainder to the primary. The prototype gives an additional procedure time units only, locks B and M, and has no split.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-05.3.1 AC 'Modifier split' read directly. Strictly the retirement is a merge, so the code implements the old RFP split-billing rule (a superseded decision) rather than a withdrawn feature; kind left as filed because the remedy is the same.

reverseFindings.title: P1 absorbed by the wrong codes, and struck through instead of shown selected at 0 units
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.2.3 is Retired but US-05.1.4 and US-03.3.4 restore it correctly: P1 is included in the six Neurosurgery and fourteen Spine codes, shown selected at 0 units, nothing locked. The prototype marks demo codes (hip x3 and shoulder x2 are not in the RVG list) and shows an inert struck-through chip with a refusal caption.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Seed lines confirmed (hip, shoulder, lumbar absorb P1). Catalogue wording splits: US-05.1.4 says not locked, US-03.3.4's first paragraph says cannot be unselected; build to US-05.1.4 and the 20 October decision.

reverseFindings.title: Ranged base code is hard-bounded to the published range
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.3.2 retired into US-03.3.1: the anaesthetist is shown the range (OQ-101 answered 29 October) and may enter any value; out-of-range warns the office, never blocks (OQ-56). The prototype already shows the range but clamps the stepper to it and refuses completion outside it.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.3.1 text and 'Out of range' AC read directly; RangeUnitsRow clamps with Math.max/min and the validator fails an out-of-range baseUnitsSelected.

reverseFindings.title: The engine re-resolves Contract and payer at billing time; nothing is locked at AUTHORISED
reverseFindings.explanation: US-08.1.2 (Retired into US-08.1.1): the engine resolves no route or payer; it reads the Contract locked to each Procedure, snapshotted at AUTHORISED (US-04.3.5). The prototype falls back to the holder's default or resolves by route, derives the payer, snapshots no Contract, and Resolve and retry changes what a re-run prices.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-08.1.1 and US-04.3.5 read directly. No Contract snapshot exists in code (only fee and rate snapshots); resolveContractForProcedure falls back by route and holder.

reverseFindings.title: Insurer master with an accepts-direct-claims flag, an Insurer route gated on it, and delivery hard-wired by insurer
reverseFindings.explanation: Retired 28 October (Donald: 'We don't have a master insurance list'): no insurer master, no direct-claims flag; an insurer is a contract holder, delivery is a holder setting (OQ-114), insurer and approval number are Booking fields with a missing number a warning. The prototype has the master and flag, an Insurers admin tab that mints a default Contract, a gated Insurer route, and upload-portal delivery by insurer kind.
reverseFindings.verify_note: FT-11.4 and US-11.4.1 notes read directly (insurers are 'just an instance of contract holders'; invoice output flag lives on the holder, US-04.1.5). All five code sites confirmed, incl. the 'Turn on' flip that creates a default Contract.

reverseFindings.title: Surgeon PDF upload and ingest is shown unbadged as product
reverseFindings.explanation: US-02.2.1 is in the Future Work swimlane. The Integrations Surgeon PDFs tab carries no Future badge while Messages and Feed config do: a facsimile beside editable rows, NHI correction and Ingest all, an Ingest PDF row demo action, and seeded surgeonPdf Bookings. OQ-108 is still unsettled after 27 October.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Swimlane 'Future Work' confirmed in US-02.2.1 frontmatter. TabButton for pdfs has no future prop; the ingest-pdf-row demo trigger has no badge.

reverseFindings.title: Automated modify, reschedule and cancel from hospital messages shown working, with a day move applied as a cross-List move
reverseFindings.explanation: All Future Work swimlane. Canned S13 to S15 messages apply with no admin: a cross-List move contradicts US-02.5.2 (a Booking on another day is cancel plus new), submitted Lists refuse inbound changes against US-02.5.4 (accepted until AUTHORISED), and a cancel of a prepaid Booking settles nothing (US-02.5.3, 28 October). Demo actions are already badged; keep S13 to S15 out of the script.
reverseFindings.verify_note: reassignBooking on S13 and the integration refusal when list.state is not ACTIVE confirmed in code; US-02.5.2 and US-02.5.4 titles and swimlanes confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: HL7 v2 to FHIR simulator, live drip, and Scenario S1 built on them
reverseFindings.explanation: HL7, FHIR and near-real-time are Future; the in-scope release is the St George's and Southern Cross download into a manual matching screen. Phase 14 badged the simulator and tabs and S1 now calls its beat an illustration, but the Integrations page intro, live-feed button and raw HL7 panes remain unbadged, and S1 still opens on a pushed message creating a Booking. Rework S1 around the matching screen when it exists.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Page intro text and live drip effect confirmed; S1 blurb already carries a Future caveat, so the residue is smaller than the original wording implied.

reverseFindings.title: Reliability tooling (retries, dead-letter queue, manual intervention): residual unbadged nav badge, patient names in the log
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-14.5 and US-14.5.1 are Future. The prototype retries three times, dead-letters, shows an unbadged amber attention badge on the side nav, offers Reprocess, and lists patient names in the message log where US-14.5.1 wants a restricted view. The Messages tab itself is already badged Future. Low priority.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Low-priority residue only: the nav badge (integrationBadge) and Patient column confirmed; the tab that hosts them is already badged Future.

reverseFindings.title: Further hospital feeds and automatic application with no matching step
reverseFindings.explanation: Further feeds and automatic matching are Future; the first release keeps a manual matching review with an unmatched queue for rows with no NHI. The prototype has three feeds including Christchurch Public and creates the Booking straight onto the List with no review, last-synced display or unmatched queue. The in-scope matching screen does not exist (code comments say 'Interim until Phase 33').
reverseFindings.verify_note: FEED-STG, FEED-CPH, FEED-SX confirmed; applyEffect S12 creates the Booking directly. The missing matching screen is a gap item (Phase 33) as well as a showcase problem.

reverseFindings.title: Billing route plus Type 1/2/3 Contracts, instead of one Contract per Procedure
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 08 route resolution and the 22 July billing-route rulings. Each Procedure selects one Contract that sets price and who is billed; behaviour is set by flags, not kinds; holders are hospitals, insurers, surgeons by practitioner ID and anaesthetists. The prototype uses a billing route, Type 1/2/3 Contracts picked by the office, and a payment category. Keep labelled until Phases 18 to 21.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.3.3, US-04.1.5, US-08.1.1 and US-11.2.1 read directly and are consistent with this. Route is required by the validator at line 125.

reverseFindings.title: The anaesthetist's edit rights end at SUBMITTED
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes binding convention 6. Reversed 16 October and confirmed 19 October: the anaesthetist can edit a submitted List until the office AUTHORISES it. The prototype refuses any anaesthetist write once SUBMITTED ('Only the office can change it now'), hides edit controls, and the submit confirm tells her she cannot change the Bookings.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-07.2.1 status 4 and its ACs ('submitted List... the change saves') read directly; refusal text and submit copy confirmed in code.

reverseFindings.title: A patient without an NHI is allowed (provisional record, NHI pending)
reverseFindings.explanation: The NHI is mandatory: no patient record without one; an incoming row without one waits at intake. On 28 October Greg proposed a stub on the List (FT-02.6, OQ-118 open); the 19 October rule stands until answered. The prototype takes NHI as optional, creates a provisional patient, shows NHI pending and seeds a no-NHI patient. Do not extend that path.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-11.1.4 ACs read directly ('cannot be saved' without NHI; no Booking or patient record from an incoming row). FT-02.6 is status 2 (Open), so the stub idea is correctly left unresolved.

reverseFindings.title: Completion rules follow the RFP route and times, not the Contract, with no modifier explanation
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 04 completion ruling. A Procedure completes with a Contract, its times (only where the Contract prices from time) and a short explanation per modifier; the RVG code is optional. The prototype requires a billing route, an RVG code or billing line, times whenever an RVG code is set, and asks for no modifier explanation.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.6.1 (status 3) read directly; validator lines confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: ASA class auto-seeds modifier units
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 22 July ASA seeding values. US-03.3.4 pre-applies only the age modifier and base-included modifiers ('No other modifier is selected for the anaesthetist, whatever the patient's ASA grade'); ASA is chosen like any modifier with an explanation. Ben (27 October) accepted pre-selected zero-value positioning modifiers and did not name ASA (OQ-95 part 1 open). The prototype auto-adds the AS code from an ASA control. Moderate confidence; labelled simplification.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.3.4 AC 'Nothing else pre-filled' and US-05.1.5 text confirm the direction; only OQ-95 part 1 (ASA) is formally open. Code confirmed (asaClass pushed into selected modifiers, ASA_SEED_UNITS).

reverseFindings.title: Post-op addendum is a new linked Booking on today's free session
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 09 reading. A pre-op or post-op event is an element on the original Procedure, and since 28 October appears on no List or schedule; how it is billed is reopened (OQ-121, US-03.7.2 back to Verify). The prototype creates a second linked Booking on a List on today's free session running a full capture, submit and authorise cycle. The code itself marks this INTERIM until Phase 38b.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.7.1 'Not on a List' AC and notes read directly; addPostOpAddendum creates a List and Booking.

reverseFindings.title: A prepaid invoice gets a full receivable and payable pair that pays the anaesthetist; the catalogue pays it into the AA Holding account
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes decision D-pre-invoice-pair. A prepayment is credited to the AA Holding account (a payables creditor, not a bank or Xero ledger account), approval is an optional step, release is a journal transfer made only by the system (trigger open, OQ-125), and cancel credits or refunds automatically. The prototype pays the anaesthetist through an ordinary pair, with no approval, holding account, transfer or cancel settlement.
reverseFindings.verify_note: xeroHandoff comment cites D-pre-invoice-pair verbatim; US-06.4.1 and OQ-115 say the payment is a transfer from the holding account, not a new invoice.

reverseFindings.title: Unavailability still produces a conflict flag, and the office path keeps the List
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phases 30 and 31. Since 19 October an anaesthetist never keeps a List on an unavailable Slot (planned or sickness): the transfer or return is forced and conflicts cover hospital closures only. The prototype still raises an Anaesthetist unavailable conflict, Simulate sickness leaves the List on the closed Slot, and the office can assign onto a closed session.
reverseFindings.verify_note: OQ-81 answer read directly ('never a conflict with the Bookings left in place'); expectedConflicts still emits kind 'availability' and simulateSickness only sets the Slot status.

reverseFindings.title: Provisional readings answered on 19 October are still built as provisional
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 32 OQ-84 and notification-pool readings. OQ-84 is answered (whoever moves a List is asked whether the vacated Slot is Free or Unavailable), so only the 'still being confirmed' label is stale. OQ-79 is answered: notices are active or resolved, cleared by a tick, never expire; the prototype keeps every notice with no resolve state.
reverseFindings.verify_note: OQ-84, OQ-79 status 4 confirmed; US-01.4.1 and US-01.4.3 state the one path for everyone. Provisional captions confirmed in code.

reverseFindings.title: The office moves a single Booking to any List on any day (lower confidence)
reverseFindings.explanation: A List never moves day (OQ-87); a single Booking moves only to a colleague free in that Slot as a new List, never into an existing List (OQ-85). The prototype's office Move booking flow lets the office pick any day and any existing List, and it has no anaesthetist-side single-Booking move at all (a gap). The catalogue states the rule for the anaesthetist's own move only, so the office half is an owner question, not a defect.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-01.4.7 opens 'In their app, an anaesthetist can move a single Booking' and OQ-85 answers the same; nothing forbids the office doing otherwise. Action changed from Rework to Keep as demo scaffold (raise with the owner); the only single-Booking move in the prototype is this office flow (grep of reassignBooking callers).

reverseFindings.title: Office edits to a Booking write through on every tap, with no Save
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 23 July write-through-per-tap ruling for the office. An admin edit applies only on an explicit Save, warns on leaving with unsaved edits and records changed fields for the update email. The Admin Booking detail wraps the same shared body, so there is no Save, Discard or unsaved warning.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-02.3.2 ACs ('Explicit save', 'Unsaved warning') read directly; no Save, Discard or unsaved text in AdminBookingDetail.tsx.

reverseFindings.title: The anaesthetist's Booking shows no calculation, units or price
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 28 September owner decision that the Card shows no calculation. US-03.1.2 has the anaesthetist see the Contract's pricing basis with the figure, and US-03.5.1 lets them change it where the Contract allows. Confirm with Donald before changing; the web List table already shows units and fee while the Booking hides them. Lower confidence (his own decision).
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.1.2 (status 4) says 'its pricing basis with the figure'; showBookingTotal is false for anaesthetists. Kept as lower confidence because the earlier ruling was Donald's.

reverseFindings.title: The payer is a per-Procedure billable-party record tied to a Billable party route
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 22 July billable-party rulings. The payer is one per Booking (parent, guardian, benefactor or family trust) and needs an email or postal address (28 October); 'there is no separate guardian record' (US-11.2.4). The prototype's New guardian sheet takes name, relationship and phone only, is per Procedure, office-only after add time, and tied to the Billable party route.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-11.2.2, US-11.2.3 and US-11.2.4 read directly; createBillableParty takes name, relationshipToPatient, phone.

reverseFindings.title: Funding split is an office-only per-line editor, not a Booking action with typed dollars or percent
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 22 July per-line funder allocation. Any user presses a split on a Procedure's Contract line and types each party's share as $ or %; each party gets its own invoice; after the combined invoice is sent a split is credit and rebill (OQ-77). The prototype's editor is office-only, per billing line, amounts only.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-08.2.3 text and ACs read directly ('a user action on the Booking', typed $ or %); sheet is rendered inside the office-only billing setup.

reverseFindings.title: Contracts are edited in place, deletable, and the billing monitor un-end-dates one to retry
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 08 contract maintenance and the S4 billing-failure beat. Each Contract is a series of dated versions, never backdated, never deleted, with changes staged and reviewed. The prototype edits terms in place, deletes unreferenced Contracts, and Resolve and retry clears an end date; the S4 demo action ends a Contract in the past.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.2.10 ('nothing is backdated and nothing is deleted') read directly; US-04.1.6 is still Proposed (status 1) so the staged-review UI is a proposal, but the versioning rule is Agreed.

reverseFindings.title: The GST report lists customer receipts, not the payments passed to the anaesthetist
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 24 July GST-activity reading. US-12.2.2 lists the payments AA made to the anaesthetist in the month with the GST of each. The prototype lists receipts on the day the customer pays, before any payout, on mobile and web. The BCTI treatment is still open (OQ-29, OQ-47).
reverseFindings.verify_note: gstActivityFor filters state.billing.receipts; US-12.2.2 says 'payments AA made to the anaesthetist... not invoices sent'.

reverseFindings.title: Dashboard Productivity and Leave panels
reverseFindings.explanation: The dashboard summarises calendar, financial position and locum availability (US-12.2.3). Productivity tiles have no backing, and Leave rows (Approved, Pending) imply an approval workflow while availability is something the anaesthetist sets herself. Both are seeded for one persona, not derived.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.3 read directly; no catalogue item mentions productivity tiles. Seed holds figures for Dr Souter only.

reverseFindings.title: Receivables ageing buckets, age chips and an Overdue view
reverseFindings.explanation: OQ-59 is answered: a flat list of unpaid payables, oldest first, no ageing buckets, no age chips, no Overdue view. Since 28 October each line links back to its Booking. The prototype has ageing bars, an Overdue tab with bucket columns and amber age chips, and rows open nothing.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.1 read directly ('no ageing buckets and no age chips'; AC 'Back to the Booking').

reverseFindings.title: Prior balance tag has no threshold and sits on the billing monitor after authorisation
reverseFindings.explanation: The alert fires when a Booking is created or matched, for an invoice unpaid beyond a 90-day threshold from the invoice date (mild or strong, never blocking), and since 28 October the anaesthetist sees it on their List. The prototype tags any open prior episode with no threshold, only on the billing monitor after authorisation, and shows the anaesthetist nothing. The tag's own tooltip admits 'not yet distinguished'.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-11.3.2 read directly (90 days from invoice date; mild vs strong; anaesthetist sees it on the Booking in their List).

reverseFindings.title: Review flag: ACC should not bill the patient directly
reverseFindings.explanation: An ACC-funded Procedure is an ordinary Procedure priced by the holder's ACC Contract; ACC is never billed directly and is invisible to the engine (US-05.5.1). The flag implies an ACC rule the engine does not have and is derived from the billing route, so it falls away with the route rework (RV-18). ACC chips on money lists are harmless.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-05.5.1 read directly; flag condition is accRelated plus billingRoute billableParty.

reverseFindings.title: Modifier master is demo values and codes that differ from the transcribed RVG table
reverseFindings.explanation: The modifier master is the RVG table plus AA's own list, values as the RVG prints them (US-05.1.5, Agreed). The prototype's table is labelled demo-plausible and disagrees (AS3 is 3 vs RVG 2, invented AS2, PO1, PO2, PA1 to PA4 values, missing VM1, TTE1/2, PACU1, EAA1, POC codes), and age codes are ordinary chips rather than pre-applied from date of birth.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Compared against requirements-board/requirements/artifacts/files/NZSA RVG 2021 modifiers.md: AS3 = 2 there, 'No AS2 or ASA V code', VM1, TTE1, TTE2, PACU1, EAA1 and POC rows exist and are absent from modifierCodes.ts.
